jobs.title: Escalation Engineer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote, United States

Category-defining tech. Career-defining work.
For more than a decade, Cockroach Labs has built database technology trusted to power some of the world's most mission-critical applications. Now, as AI transforms how software is created and operated, the infrastructure behind it has to keep pace. Cockroach Continuum is built to meet this moment, bringing individual databases together into one fleet designed for agentic applications, where AI agents help teams provision, scale, and optimize workloads at machine speed.
The customers you'll work with are some of the most innovative businesses in the world, and the problems they're trying to solve are real and urgent. You'll bring a genuinely differentiated product to a market moving fast, at a company positioned to lead it. The people who thrive here are the ones who want to own that opportunity.

The Role
We're looking for an Escalation Engineer to join the Cockroach Labs Technical Support team in the AMER region. You will be the escalation point for the most challenging customer issues: reviewing, assisting with, or taking over cases that need more expertise or oversight, and driving resolution with other departments. You are expected to work with a high level of autonomy and resolve complex issues quickly.
This is a remote role open to candidates in the Pacific or Mountain time zone, as the team operates in Pacific time zone hours.

You Will

• Provide advanced support to customers and front-line technical support engineers to diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex issues via CRM, Slack, video chat, and/or remote access.

• Act as a point of escalation for tickets with no clear path to resolution where the Technical Support team has exhausted available tools and processes.

• Identify when a ticket or account requires additional support and act proactively to course correct.

• Use AI-assisted tooling in your investigations, including log and debug-bundle analysis, reproduction scaffolding, and code reading, and verify its output before it reaches a customer or an engineer.

• Evaluate how escalations could have been avoided, and contribute to process, tooling, and observability improvements that reduce escalations and time to resolution, including where AI tooling could help.

• Provide training and mentorship to junior support staff, sharing knowledge and expertise to help them handle complex issues more effectively.

• Share effective AI workflows with the team, and help front-line engineers learn where AI output is reliable and where it needs independent verification.

• Maintain detailed and accurate documentation of ongoing cases, including steps taken, findings, and proposed solutions.

• Advocate for the customer within the organization, ensuring that their concerns are understood and addressed appropriately.

• Participate in on-call and shift rotations with transfer of cases to other geographic regions in a “follow the sun” methodology.

• Stay updated on new features, technologies, and best practices related to the products or services supported.

The Expectations
In your first 30 days, you'll learn CockroachDB, our customers, and our company through a self-guided onboarding platform of reading and hands-on exercises. By the end of the month, you'll be assisting customers directly.
After 3 months, you'll be fully integrated into the team and will be familiar with the various systems we use. You'll be able to manage most issues from customers and will be able to contribute to improving the scope and quality of our offerings. As our team and your expertise grow, you’ll begin mentoring and training new members of the team, developing and updating training and documentation to ensure that knowledge is not lost.

You Have

• 7+ years of experience working in Technical Support or a similar technical role at a software company.

• Strong knowledge of databases and the ability to read and write SQL.

• Knowledge of distributed systems, Linux, and an understanding of software development.

• Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, including root cause analysis, in a global 24x7x365 environment.

• Experience using AI tools to troubleshoot and diagnose technical issues, an understanding of their common failure modes, and the judgment to verify their output before relying on it.

• A customer-first approach to critical thinking.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, including adjusting tone and content for technical and non-technical audiences, and a passion for working with users directly.

• The polish expected when working with Fortune 500 enterprise customers.

• Familiarity with, or willingness to learn, the technologies behind enterprise applications.

• The ability to absorb information. You love getting into the weeds technically, but don't let that distract you from achieving your goals.

• The ability to participate in a weekend on-call rotation.

Cockroach Labs is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you need additional accommodations to feel comfortable during your interview process, please email us at accessibility@cockroachlabs.com .
Cockroach Labs has a hybrid work model, with Roachers that are local to one of our offices coming in on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays and working flexibly the rest of the week. While we’ve learned valuable lessons working remotely, nothing can replace the connection, creativity, and fun that occurs when Roachers get together and we are committed to fostering a workplace that encourages collaboration and allows us all to do our best work.

Benefits

• Stock Options

• Medical Insurance

• Vision Insurance

• Dental Insurance

• Life and Disability Insurance

• Professional Development Funds

• Flexible Time Off

• Paid Holidays

• Paid Sick Days

• Paid Parental Leave

• Retirement Benefits

• Mental Wellbeing Benefits

• And more!

The annual anticipated base salary range for candidates for this role is listed below. Salary is one component of the Cockroach Labs’ Total Rewards package, which also includes: stock options, medical insurance, vision insurance, dental insurance, life and disability insurance, funds for professional development, flexible paid time off, paid sick days and holidays, paid parental leave, and wellbeing benefits. We have a match on 401(k) contributions in the U.S.
We set competitive pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and geographic location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Benefits programs are designed according to local market practices. Actual salaries may vary and fall outside of this range depending on factors such as a candidate’s qualifications, geographic location, skills, experience, and competencies. In addition, we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted.

Annual Anticipated Base Salary Range
$130,000 — $180,000 USD

jobs.title: Lead-to-Cash Business Partner
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote United States
BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio.
Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself.
The Role
We are seeking a Lead-to-Cash Business Partner to support and continuously improve our Salesforce-enabled Lead-to-Cash processes across various business areas such as Revenue Operations, Finance, Quote to Order, Order to Cash, and Customer Success to surface and understand business needs, define well-scoped enhancement requests, and drive improvements through a structured Lead-to-Cash governance model.
This is an individual contributor role that sits at the intersection of business process, system governance, and analytical rigor. The ideal candidate brings strong discovery instincts, a genuine curiosity for root cause problem-solving, and the ability to challenge and sharpen business asks before they enter the delivery pipeline. Salesforce familiarity, business judgment, strong interpersonal skills, and requirements rigor are the core of this role.
What You’ll Do
Business Partnership & Discovery

• Partner with business stakeholders across assigned workstreams to understand current-state challenges, process friction, and desired outcomes

• Apply strong discovery discipline to go beyond what stakeholders ask for to diagnose root cause, clarify the true business problem, and influence and advise on the solution path

• Challenge and refine business asks with intellectual curiosity and a solutions-oriented mindset, ensuring requests are grounded in measurable outcomes rather than assumed solutions

• Build trusted relationships across the business areas

Enhancement Definition & Intake

• Conduct initial intake review of submitted enhancement requests, assessing completeness, strategic alignment, and impact to translate findings into well-structured business justifications with defined outcomes and success metrics

• Ensure requests account for end-to-end process and system impacts before progressing through the governance process

• Incorporate bugs alongside enhancements in business lead conversations to build a holistic, impact-driven prioritization view across all request types.

Technical Review & Effort Estimation Support

• Use HLE outputs to rationalize business value against estimated complexity, supporting informed prioritization decisions before requests enter the SF Solutioning queue

• Collaborate with other L2C Business Partners on technically complex requests to ensure solution approach considerations are surfaced early

Salesforce CoE Partnership & Delivery Support

• Act as a business process partner to the Salesforce CoE

• Collaborate with the SF CoE on requirements clarification, solution validation, and prioritization

• Ensure delivered solutions align with defined business outcomes and original success criteria

Documentation, Governance & Communication

• Maintain Business area-level process documentation and L2C artifacts

• Communicate enhancement and prioritization decisions, roadmap updates, and Salesforce releases to Business Leads in clear, non-technical language

• Translate technical changes into business-focused messaging that supports stakeholder adoption

Continuous Improvement

• Monitor Lead-to-Cash process feedback and workstream health to proactively identify improvement opportunities

• Recommend system and process enhancements that improve efficiency, data quality, and scalability across the L2C process

• Approach every aspect of the role with an AI-first mindset. Continuously identifying and applying AI capabilities to improve how the L2C team operates and how BeyondTrust’s systems, processes, and enhancements are evaluated, defined, and delivered

What You’ll Bring

• 4–7 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Business Systems, Sales Operations, or a related role with direct exposure to Salesforce-enabled processes

• Strong discovery and requirements skills—demonstrated ability to dig beneath surface-level requests, identify root cause, and define the real problem before recommending a solution

• Solid understanding of Lead-to-Cash processes including lead management, opportunity management, quoting, contracting, and order management

• Hands-on familiarity with Salesforce in a B2B environment

• Proven ability to build relationships with business stakeholders and influence prioritization decisions without direct authority

• Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complexity into clear, stakeholder-ready language

• Demonstrated curiosity and initiative in exploring AI tools, with a track record of finding meaningful ways to incorporate them into day-to-day work

Nice To Have

• Experience in SaaS or cybersecurity organizations

• Exposure to Salesforce CPQ and GTM Tools

• Background in consulting, technical product management, or business process architecture

• Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery models and working alongside a Salesforce Center of Excellence

Better Together
Diversity. Inclusion. They’re more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected.
We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.

About Us
BeyondTrust is the global identity security leader protecting Paths to Privilege™. Our identity-centric approach goes beyond securing privileges and access, empowering organizations with the most effective solution to manage the entire identity attack surface and neutralize threats, whether from external attacks or insiders.
BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. We are trusted by 20,000 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 100, and our global ecosystem of partners.
Learn more at www.beyondtrust.com .

jobs.title: Accounting Manager
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote US
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Finance team
The Finance team ensures Affirm remains financially sound and strategically positioned for growth. Our team manages financial planning, accounting, pricing, vendor management, tax, investor relations, and corporate development. We deliver timely insights, accurate reporting, and careful analysis to support decision-making. From day-to-day financial operations to major investments, we enable sustainable, informed growth by maintaining strong fiscal discipline.

About the role
Affirm is looking for an experienced Accounting Manager to support and manage our international accounting operations, with a focus on statutory accounting, statutory audits, financial statement preparation, local compliance requirements, transfer pricing, and monthly close activities.
In this role, you will help ensure Affirm’s international entities are supported by accurate books and records, timely close execution, audit-ready documentation, and compliant local reporting. You will coordinate closely with internal Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Payroll, People, Finance, Technical Accounting and Financial Reporting teams, as well as external auditors, accounting firms, tax advisors, and statutory service providers.
You will bring strong US GAAP and local statutory accounting awareness, excellent project management skills, and the ability to manage multiple workstreams across jurisdictions. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, highly organized, proactive, and comfortable driving work through cross-functional partners and external providers.
You will be expected to deliver reliable, high-quality results, communicate clearly, and improve processes that make statutory accounting, audit support, and transfer pricing activities more scalable over time. You are a strong problem solver and communicator who is excited to support Affirm’s continued growth and mission to deliver honest financial products that improve lives.

What you’ll do

• Manage statutory accounting and monthly close activities for international entities, including journal entries, accruals, reconciliations, variance analysis, and close checklist completion.

• Coordinate with external accounting, payroll, tax, statutory, and audit providers to ensure accurate local books, timely deliverables, and compliance with local requirements.

• Lead statutory audit planning and execution, including auditor onboarding, timelines, status tracking, request management, issue resolution, and stakeholder coordination.

• Prepare and review statutory financial statements, disclosures, footnotes, supporting schedules, and tie-outs to trial balances, reconciliations, and audit evidence.

• Own PBC coordination and audit testing support by gathering, validating, reviewing, and submitting accurate and complete audit documentation.

• Partner with Technical Accounting, Financial Reporting, Tax, Legal, Treasury, Payroll, People, Finance, and external advisors on local accounting requirements, statutory adjustments, and reporting matters.

• Manage audit completion and filing activities, including open item resolution, final approvals, signed documents, filing coordination, and completed audit file retention.

• Own or support transfer pricing calculations, intercompany invoicing, related journal entries, reconciliations, settlements, and cross-functional alignment.

• Review trial balances, general ledger activity, reconciliations, and financial statement variances to identify risks, unusual items, required adjustments, and recurring issues.

• Strengthen process improvements and controls across statutory accounting and audit workflows by standardizing templates, improving review checklists, clarifying ownership, documenting key judgments, enhancing audit trails, and building repeatable processes that reduce manual effort, improve accuracy, and support audit readiness.

• Identify control gaps, process inefficiencies, and documentation weaknesses; partner with stakeholders to implement scalable solutions, improve close governance, and ensure processes remain effective as entities, requirements, and reporting complexity evolve.

• Use systems and tools such as NetSuite, Blackline, Excel, Workday, and AI-enabled workflows to improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.

What we look for

• CPA professional accounting designation; or 6+ years of relevant professional accounting experience with a bachelor’s degree in business or finance.

• Public accounting experience preferred, especially audit experience with multinational or public company clients.

• Strong knowledge of US GAAP, statutory accounting, financial statement preparation, account reconciliations, journal entries, and month-end close.

• Experience supporting or managing statutory audits, including PBC coordination, audit testing, financial statement review, audit completion, and filing.

• Experience working with international entities, local accounting requirements, statutory reporting, and external service providers.

• Experience with transfer pricing calculations, intercompany invoicing, intercompany reconciliations, and cross-border accounting activity.

• Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple audits, deadlines, entities, and stakeholders at once.

• Excellent attention to detail and ability to produce accurate, complete, audit-ready work under tight timelines.

• Ability to partner effectively with Technical Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Payroll, People, Finance, external auditors, and local accounting providers.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain audit status, accounting issues, risks, and recommendations clearly.

• Advanced Excel skills, including lookups, conditional formulas, pivot tables, large dataset analysis, and financial statement support.

• Experience with accounting systems and close management tools; NetSuite and Blackline experience preferred.

• Strong ownership mindset and desire to improve processes, reduce manual work, and make accounting workflows more scalable over time.

• Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment with competing priorities.

Base Pay Grade - K
Equity Grade - 6
Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.
Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)
USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $ 145,000 - $ 205,000
USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $ 128,000 - $ 188,000

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.
Benefits designed for you
Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

• Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Headquarters: US - Remote
Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.

Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

Our vision: A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.

About the Role:
You'll own your outcomes, from the strategies you run to the conversations that shape what we build next. As a Senior Customer Success Manager at Wrike, you will own, protect, and exponentially grow the strategic relationship for a high-value portfolio of Enterprise accounts across North America. Wrike has evolved beyond standard project management into a trusted work delivery platform for people and AI, and in this role, you will be the chief architect of that vision for our most strategic clients.
In this role, you are a strategic business consultant and a trusted advisor. You will guide client executives through complex business transformations, leveraging cutting-edge Wrike AI Agents, Wrike Copilot, and visual collaboration tools to map, optimize, and scale business workflows. You will partner deeply with Sales, Renewals, and Product counterparts to deliver on the transformational vision and establish Wrike as the clients' long-term operating system of record.

Your Impact:

• Strategic Portfolio Ownership: Proactively manage a highly diverse and complex book of North American Enterprise accounts, serving as their strategic partner, executive liaison, and primary advocate.

• Build Stakeholder Relationships: Establish a multi-layered relationship structure - including Centers of Excellence - connecting with administrators, day-to-day champions, and executive-level sponsors (VPs, C-suite).

• Co-Create Success Plans & Workflows: Build scalable and highly digestible Success Plans that capture the client's transformational vision and a measurable roadmap to build it out.

• Play Offense: Actively hunt for expansion paths within your portfolio. You will not wait for renewals to talk about growth; instead, you will proactively identify new teams to land, pitch advanced AI use cases, and systematically build a high-velocity expansion pipeline in lockstep with Sales.

• Commercial Growth & Retention: Meet individual Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) and Net Revenue Retention (NRR) targets by proactively identifying expansion opportunities, mapping customer growth plans, and mitigating churn risks early.

• Operational Excellence: You will continuously iterate on processes, develop new workflow playbooks, and share documented learnings across the broader organization.

Your Qualifications:

• Proven GTM Track Record: 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Business Consulting roles within the SaaS space, with a verified track record of managing $100K+ ARR accounts.

• Change Management & COE Mastery: Proven expertise in guiding large-scale organizations through complex software rollouts and operational transformations by mapping and navigating stakeholder management and building internal Centers of Excellence (COEs).

• Executive Presence & Storytelling: Highly polished communication skills with a proven capability to establish radical trust, navigate political dynamics, and present quantified business value/ROI to C-suite and VP-level technology leaders.

• Commercial Acumen & C-Suite Framing: A proven history of partnering with Sales to build joint account plans, identify upsell opportunities, and guide customers through complex buying cycles. jobs.description:
Headquarters: New York, NY (Remote)
At Talkspace, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and belonging-centered workplace where everyone can thrive while making a difference in mental health. Want to help over two million people receive quality mental healthcare? Come join our mission of getting therapy in the hands of everyone!

We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst to join our Data Science team. The Data Analyst is a key contributor to the product development of Sentia’s agentic behavioral health platform, utilizing a strong data-driven approach. This role involves seamlessly collaborating with various technical and non-technical stakeholders to translate data insights into actionable strategies and communicating the underlying data narrative to non-technical audiences. This analyst will be crucial in the initial setup and architecture of the data warehouse, establishing the foundation for all data operations.
Key responsibilities include collecting requirements, querying databases, and developing dashboards and reports for both internal business stakeholders and external partners. The analyst excels in both qualitative and quantitative data analysis, identifying trends and surfacing crucial insights that lead to informed decision-making, and also excels in consumer product analysis.To work at Talkspace, you need to be as passionate as we are about our work, and excited to partner with us on delivering quality mental healthcare.
This is a remote position based in Eastern Hours. Talkspace Headquarters in NYC.
What You’ll Do

• Data Visualization and Reporting
• Develop and refine data visualizations that clearly communicate outcomes, network performance, and user engagement trends to stakeholders.

• Create automated quality reports and network performance dashboards using Looker and other tools.

• Deeply understand and analyze user pathways, business outcomes, and the dynamics of our provider/partner network.

• Quantitative Analysis
• Conduct thorough quantitative analyses to support business strategies.

• Utilize your expertise in SQL and Python to manage business and provider data effectively.

• Strategic Insights
• Collaborate with business, finance, marketing and cross-functional teams to provide data-driven insights supporting product development and provider network operations.

• Navigate the intricacies of a multi-sided marketplace, understanding different stakeholder needs and market drivers.

• Communication and Collaboration
• Engage with both technical and non-technical stakeholders to transform complex data insights into understandable and actionable strategies for enhancing customer service and provider engagement.

• Work closely with a seasoned Data Science team to leverage advanced analytics in shaping business and network intelligence strategies.

• Create and present easily digestible and actionable recommendations to senior leadership, influencing key decision-making processes.

• Data Modeling and Pipeline Management Design
• Build, and maintain robust, documented, and scalable data models (e.g., using dbt) within the data warehouse to support downstream reporting and analytical needs.

• Collaborate with engineering teams to optimize data ingestion processes (ETL/ELT) and ensure the timely availability of high-quality data.

• Analyze agentic platform performance metrics
• Metrics include model accuracy, latency, conversation depth, and user adherence to behavioral protocols.

About You

• 3-5 years of experience in an analytical role, experience with healthcare data (patient outcomes, capacity planning, etc.) a plus.

• BA/BS in a quantitative field like statistics, applied mathematics, economics, computer science, or equivalent experience.

• Proficiency in SQL, python, and Excel / Google Sheets.

• Comfortable with statistics and data manipulation.

• Advanced skills in data visualization tools like Looker or Tableau are essential.

• Experience with product analytics tools like Mixpanel.

• Experience with leveraging GenAI tools is a plus.

Benefits

• Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision plans coverage

• Pre-tax benefits: HSA/ FSA

• 401k Retirement Savings Program with matching up to 3%

• Voluntary benefits including disability, basic life or pet insurance, etc.

• Monthly Wellness Stipend to promote mental and physical self-care

• Flexible PTO and Remote First Environment

• Regular team events, including Wellness Workshops and Team Building Events

• Free access to Talkspace products for you and one household member, as well as access to a friends and family discount!

Compensation
At Talkspace, we believe that pay transparency during the interview process is a critical part of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our salary bands are based on internal and external compensation benchmarks, which we regularly evaluate to ensure we pay competitively.
The base salary range for this role is between $110,000 and $130,000. Within the salary bands, leveling corresponds to each candidate’s relevant experience, skills as assessed during the interview process, education, and applicable certifications.
Why Talkspace?
Talkspace is the world’s leading online therapy company, serving over 2 million users looking to begin their wellness journey through tele-health. According to the World Health Organization, close to 1 billion people worldwide live with a mental disorder, and on average more than 75% with mental, neurological, and substance use disorders receive no treatment for their condition at all. Additionally, one-third of the world’s population – 2 billion people – live in countries that spend less than 1% of their health budgets on mental health. Therapy is an universal need and it's our mission here to change the world by cultivating an intentional space for people to feel supported through quality care that is simple and accessible.
Combining our passion for innovation along with our desire to help others overcome the stigma behind “getting help,” we are transforming the way patients find the right care provider, making an otherwise impossible feat easily conquerable. Our network of licensed, accredited, and board-certified clinicians are increasing access to mental health for our members through a myriad of high quality therapy services: anytime and for a fraction of the price. Dedicated to our mission, we are looking for candidates that want to bring their talents into a diverse “for purpose” space. If you’re equally as passionate about making quality mental healthcare accessible to all then Talkspace is the right place for you!

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER
Talkspace welcomes and celebrates talent from all backgrounds, perspectives, and walks of life to foster an innovative and diverse workforce. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification or if your path has been nontraditional — such as not completing a formal degree program, taking a career break, or having a prior criminal record — if you believe you could make a great addition to this team. Come as you are and learn about the exciting opportunities on our team.
Individuals seeking employment at Talkspace are considered without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, marital, parental, veteran or military status, unfavorable military discharge, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law.
How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace?
Diversity
Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.
Equity
Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.
Inclusion
Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.
Belonging
Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.title: Care Coordinator Manager
jobs.description:
Headquarters: New York, NY (Remote)
At Talkspace, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and belonging-centered workplace where everyone can thrive while making a difference in mental health. Want to help over two million people receive quality mental healthcare? Come join our mission of getting therapy in the hands of everyone!

We are looking for an experienced Care Coordinator Manager to join our Referral Management team. This role would be responsible for leading a team of Care Coordinators who support patients throughout their care journey, from initial activation and appointment preparation to ongoing engagement, discharge support, and transitions to a higher level of care. You will work closely with patients, providers, UHS facilities, and cross-functional partners to identify and address barriers to care, coordinate transitions between levels of care, and ensure patients receive consistent, high-quality support throughout their treatment journey. You will also partner with Clinical, Quality, Product, and Network teams to improve patient engagement, develop standardized workflows, and build scalable care coordination capabilities.
We are looking for someone who is a strong, patient-focused leader with excellent organizational and problem-solving skills, who is passionate about making a meaningful impact and bringing their talents into a “for purpose” space. To work at Talkspace, you need to be as passionate as we are about our work, and excited to partner with us on delivering quality mental healthcare.
This is a remote position based on Eastern Time. Talkspace Headquarters is located in NYC.
What You’ll Do

• Care Coordinator Team Management
• Lead, manage, and develop a team of Care Coordinators responsible for supporting patients throughout their care journey.

• Establish clear performance expectations, provide ongoing coaching and feedback, and support professional development of team members.

• Monitor team performance and ensure Care Coordinators consistently meet established productivity, quality, and patient engagement expectations.

• Oversee Care Coordinator performance metrics, including call completion, patient outreach, and follow-through on assigned activities.

• Identify performance trends and implement strategies to address gaps and improve team effectiveness.

• Ensure consistent application of Care Coordination workflows, processes, and patient engagement standards across the team.

• Patient Support & Engagement
• Oversee patient support and activation activities, including monitoring required lead-up paperwork and ensuring timely account activation.

• Ensure patients receive appropriate outreach and support prior to their first appointment and throughout their initial engagement with care.

• Monitor the patient journey and oversee efforts to support engagement during the first 30 days of care.

• Ensure appropriate follow-up occurs for patients who miss appointments and help prevent inappropriate billing related to missed first appointments.

• Provide support to discharge planners as needed to facilitate continuity of care and successful transitions.

• Monitor patient engagement and identify barriers that may prevent patients from accessing or remaining engaged in care.

• Escalation & Step-Up in Care
• Oversee processes for identifying patients who may require escalation or transition to a higher level of care.

• Partner with Talkspace providers and patients to coordinate smooth transitions back to an appropriate UHS facility when a higher level of care is needed.

• Identify the appropriate UHS facility based on patient needs and coordinate directly with facility stakeholders to facilitate scheduling and transition of care.

• Ensure timely communication and follow-through among patients, providers, Care Coordinators, and facility partners throughout the escalation process.

• Partner with Clinical and Quality teams to establish standardized workflows and protocols for escalation and step-up care.

• Monitor trends and operational barriers related to care transitions and recommend opportunities for improvement.

• Performance & Quality Management
• Establish and monitor team success metrics and performance goals aligned with patient and business outcomes.

• Track Care Coordinator productivity, including call completion and outreach activity.

• Monitor patient engagement and HEDIS-related measures, including the percentage of appointments attended within 7 and 30 days.

• Review performance data to identify trends, gaps, and opportunities for improvement.

• Develop and implement action plans to improve team performance and patient engagement outcomes.

• Partner with Clinical and Quality teams to ensure Care Coordination processes support quality and patient care objectives.

• Product Strategy & Development
• Partner with Product, Clinical, Quality, and Network teams to identify opportunities to improve Care Coordination capabilities and patient workflows.

• Establish standardized patient engagement and outreach plans to create a consistent experience across the patient journey.

• Develop and implement workflows designed to streamline escalation and step-up care processes.

• Provide operational and user insights to inform the development and enhancement of Care Coordination tools and technology.

• Support the development of a Care Coordinator-specific arm, profile, or workflow within the referral tool.

• Identify opportunities to leverage technology, automation, and improved workflows to increase team efficiency and patient engagement.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Work closely with Network Strategy, Clinical, Quality, Product, and Operations teams to align priorities and improve patient care workflows.

• Build and maintain strong working relationships with Talkspace providers and UHS facility stakeholders.

• Communicate operational needs, performance trends, challenges, and opportunities to appropriate internal stakeholders.

• Coordinate cross-functional initiatives and ensure appropriate follow-through on action items and deliverables.

• Contribute to a collaborative, solutions-oriented environment focused on improving patient outcomes and the overall care experience.

• Other Responsibilities
• Performs other related duties as assigned.

• Provides operational and strategic support to the Network Strategy and Client Experience teams as needed.

About You

• 3+ years of experience in healthcare operations, care coordination, patient engagement, case management, project management, or a related field required.

• Experience managing teams responsible for patient or member outreach and engagement.

• Strong understanding of patient care journeys, care transitions, and coordination between levels of care.

• Experience developing or improving operational workflows, processes, and team procedures.

• Experience using performance metrics and data to monitor team effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement.

• Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and initiatives simultaneously.

• Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

• Ability to identify operational challenges, anticipate barriers, and develop practical solutions.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate with patients, providers, facility stakeholders, and internal teams.

• Comfortable working cross-functionally with Clinical, Quality, Product, Network, and Operations teams.

• Highly detail-oriented with a strong focus on accuracy, accountability, and follow-through.

• Ability to work independently and take ownership of initiatives from planning through implementation.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving healthcare environment and adapting to changing priorities.

Bonus Points

• 1+ years of people management or demonstrated experience leading and developing teams preferred.

• Active, independent clinical (social work, counseling, etc) licensure preferred.

• Experience working within healthcare systems, behavioral health, telehealth, or a distributed provider network preferred.

• Familiarity with HEDIS measures, patient engagement metrics, or other healthcare quality measures preferred.

Benefits

• Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision plans

• Pre-tax benefits: HSA/ FSA

• 401k Retirement Savings Program with matching up to 4%

• Voluntary benefits including disability, basic life or pet insurance, etc.

• Monthly Wellness Stipend to promote mental and physical self-care

• Flexible PTO and Remote First Environment

• Regular team events, including Wellness Workshops and Team Building Events

• Free access to Talkspace products for you and one household member, as well as access to a friends and family discount!

Compensation
At Talkspace, we believe that pay transparency during the interview process is a critical part of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our salary bands are based on internal and external compensation benchmarks, which we regularly evaluate to ensure we pay competitively.
The base salary range for this role is between $75,000 and $95,000/yr. Within the salary bands, leveling corresponds to each candidate’s relevant experience, skills as assessed during the interview process, education, and applicable certifications.
Why Talkspace?
Talkspace is the world’s leading online therapy company, serving over 2 million users looking to begin their wellness journey through tele-health. According to the World Health Organization, close to 1 billion people worldwide live with a mental disorder, and on average more than 75% with mental, neurological, and substance use disorders receive no treatment for their condition at all. Additionally, one-third of the world’s population – 2 billion people – live in countries that spend less than 1% of their health budgets on mental health. Therapy is an universal need and it's our mission here to change the world by cultivating an intentional space for people to feel supported through quality care that is simple and accessible.
Combining our passion for innovation along with our desire to help others overcome the stigma behind “getting help,” we are transforming the way patients find the right care provider, making an otherwise impossible feat easily conquerable. Our network of licensed, accredited, and board-certified clinicians are increasing access to mental health for our members through a myriad of high quality therapy services: anytime and for a fraction of the price. Dedicated to our mission, we are looking for candidates that want to bring their talents into a diverse “for purpose” space. If you’re equally as passionate about making quality mental healthcare accessible to all then Talkspace is the right place for you!

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER
Talkspace welcomes and celebrates talent from all backgrounds, perspectives, and walks of life to foster an innovative and diverse workforce. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification or if your path has been nontraditional — such as not completing a formal degree program, taking a career break, or having a prior criminal record — if you believe you could make a great addition to this team. Come as you are and learn about the exciting opportunities on our team.
Individuals seeking employment at Talkspace are considered without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, marital, parental, veteran or military status, unfavorable military discharge, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law.
How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace?
Diversity
Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.
Equity
Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.
Inclusion
Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.
Belonging
Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

Headquarters: Atlanta, GA - Hybrid; Burlingame, CA - Hybrid; Denver, CO - Hybrid; New York, NY - Hybrid; San Francisco, CA - Hybrid; Scottsdale, AZ - Hybrid; Toronto, Ontario - Remote

About Gusto
At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.
All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy .
AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role
Gusto is looking for a seasoned performance marketer to own execution across paid social and emerging acquisition channels, testing new platforms, formats, and tactics to find what works before scaling. This is a high-visibility role at the intersection of performance marketing, channel experimentation, and AI-powered workflow design. You will own execution and day-to-day strategy for paid social and new channel tests, working within Gusto's demand generation framework, with clear accountability to pipeline and revenue targets.
About the Team
As a member of Gusto's Demand Generation team, you will be embedded specifically within Paid Acquisition, a focused group responsible for driving awareness and pipeline through paid media. This team operates with high autonomy, a bias for experimentation, and a culture of cross-functional partnership. We hold ourselves to a high standard, move fast, and genuinely believe that being AI-native is part of what it means to do this job well today.
Here's what you'll do day-to-day:

• Own paid social strategy and execution across Meta, LinkedIn, Reddit, Quora, and TikTok, driving full-funnel campaigns from brand awareness through retargeting and conversion, with accountability to pipeline and revenue targets.

• Manage significant, multi-million dollar budgets with rigor, including campaign pacing, forecasting, budget-vs-actuals analysis, and making the case for paid social investment in imperfect attribution environments.

• Apply and help refine Gusto's paid acquisition measurement framework, including attribution philosophy and budget allocation principles, in partnership with the broader marketing team. jobs.description:
Headquarters: San Francisco Bay Area or Remote (West Coast)
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Discord's Enterprise Technology org is building a software engineering discipline from the ground up, and this is the founding engineering hire. There is no Enterprise Platform team yet. You will not be maintaining a status quo or joining an existing backlog: you will define the discipline, set the technical foundation, and build the platform that lets the internal systems enabling Discordians scale with the company.
Discord's mission is to cultivate belonging, and doing that at scale requires internal systems that move as fast as the product itself. The mission of this role is to turn our enterprise infrastructure into self-service software. Your job is to replace manual consoles and tickets with a platform of reusable primitives, building blocks like "provision a device" or "push an IAM policy or app integration through code," exposed through clean APIs and self-service portals. As a code-forward Staff engineer, you will design abstractions that hide the messy reality of Okta, Jamf, and Terraform (our identity, device management, and infrastructure-as-code tools) behind interfaces people actually want to use, operating with a platform-as-a-product mindset.
What You'll Do

• Manage the device fleet as code: Move device configuration off consoles and into versioned, API-driven infrastructure for endpoint management and hardware provisioning.

• Automate the identity layer: Manage identity systems and their connections to downstream apps as code, from SSO and SCIM integrations to account workflows, so changes ship through version control and CI/CD instead of an admin console.

• Own app delivery and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC): Build deployment pipelines and provisioning patterns that let internal systems be built and changed safely, establishing CI/CD standards.

• Build the self-service layer: Design and ship the APIs, CLIs, and portals that compose primitives into paved paths, like a new hire's first day, where software access and group memberships land in one automated, auditable flow.

• Set the foundation: Define the technical direction and architecture for the discipline, writing the RFCs and documentation that future hires will build on.

What You Should Have

• 6+ years building and operating production software and systems at a technology company, with a track record of owning ambiguous projects end to end.

• Strong software engineering fundamentals. You write production code (we lean on Python, TypeScript and Rust), and design, test, and ship it. This is not a systems admin role.

• Deep, hands-on IAM experience (SSO, SCIM, OAuth/OIDC, RBAC) and fluency with infrastructure as code (Terraform) and CI/CD.

• Experience treating endpoint and fleet management as an API-driven engineering surface at scale.

• A platform-as-a-product mindset. You have built self-service tooling that people chose to adopt.

• Comfort with ambiguity and a founder's temperament; energized by building from scratch.

Bonus Points

• Hands-on experience with Okta, Jamf, or Intune.

• Experience with identity and access governance for non-human, workload, or AI-agent principals.

• Background at a high-growth consumer tech company with a highly technical employee base.

Headquarters: Amsterdam, Netherlands; Belgrade, Serbia; Berlin, Germany; Paphos, Cyprus; Remote, Germany; Warsaw, Poland

Founding Tech Lead (GrowthBricks)
Are you a hands-on engineer who loves zero-to-one challenges? Do you want to build systems with real context and memory that do more than reason, use tools, and drive actual business outcomes?

About JetBrains
We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.
GrowthBricks is a new project at JetMinds, backed by JetBrains, designed to give GTM teams and AI agents a shared business brain. Business context usually gets fragmented across CRMs, documents, dashboards, and people's heads. GrowthBricks brings that context together so agents and people can make decisions and execute effectively across the sales, marketing, and product stack.

About GrowthBricks
GrowthBricks is a shared business brain for GTM teams and AI agents.
It brings together the context that usually lives across CRM, docs, dashboards, tools, and people’s heads: who we sell to, why customers buy, what matters now, what we tried, and what worked. Agents and people use that context to decide what to do next and execute across the GTM stack.
GrowthBricks is a new project at JetMinds, backed by JetBrains.

About the role
We’re looking for a hands-on Founding Tech Lead to build GrowthBricks from zero.
You’ll work directly with the product founder and own the technical side of the product: architecture, core systems, integrations, and the agent layer.
The core challenge is turning fragmented, changing business context into reliable memory and agent actions across tools and measuring whether those actions actually drive business outcomes.
You’ll write a lot of the early code yourself, make the key technical decisions, and shape the product as we learn what works.

What you’ll work on

• Design the core architecture: business context, agents, tools, integrations, and feedback loops.

• Build agentic workflows that can reason over company context and act across CRM, sales, marketing, and product systems.

• Build context extractors from GTM team artifacts like sales calls, emails, internal documents, CRM state, marketing campaigns, etc.

• Work on prompting, context management, memory, tool use, and orchestration.

• Connect GrowthBricks to the existing GTM stack rather than rebuilding everything around it.

• Decide where to use MCP, APIs, frameworks, or third-party tools and where a custom solution is worth it.

• Prototype fast, discard weak ideas, and turn the useful ones into product primitives.

We expect that you

• Are a strong hands-on engineer who enjoys zero-to-one work.

• Have built with LLMs, agents, or agentic workflows used by real people, and improved them based on failures, evaluations, and user feedback.

• Understand how context, prompting, tools, and agent behavior fit together.

• Can design backend systems, APIs, data models, and integrations.

• Are comfortable making decisions before all the answers are known.

• Prefer simple, pragmatic solutions over unnecessary complexity.

We’re especially interested if you

• Have worked in solution engineering, sales engineering, pre-sales, or built software for GTM teams.

• Understand the modern GTM stack: CRM, enrichment, outbound, automation, and product signals.

• Have automated sales or marketing workflows, ideally with agents or LLMs.

• Have owned a technical product from a blank repo to something people actually used.

GTM experience is not mandatory, but if you already understand how sales and marketing teams work, that is a strong advantage.

What we offer

• A competitive salary and strong benefits package.

• The runway and resources of an established company, with startup-level autonomy.

• A founding role with direct influence over both product and architecture.

• Real users and real workflows from day one.

• Freedom to choose the stack, tools, and technical approach.

• A chance to help define what an agent-native GTM product should look like.

jobs.title: Product User Research, Intern
jobs.description:
ABOUT SARVAM AI

Sarvam AI is building India's sovereign AI stack, spanning foundational models, infrastructure and applications. Our mission is to make powerful AI accessible and useful for India, building technology that works across languages, industries and real-world use cases.

As we continue to build and scale our products, understanding how people interact with them becomes increasingly important. We're looking for a curious and research-oriented intern to help us understand our users better and shape the experiences we build.



THE ROLE

As a Product User Research Intern, you'll work closely with our product, design and engineering teams to understand user behaviour, identify friction points and uncover opportunities to improve our products.

You'll interact directly with developers, product managers and founders, study how they use Sarvam's products, and translate your findings into actionable insights that influence product and design decisions.

This is an opportunity to work on a new user research function at Sarvam, helping establish research practices and processes from the ground up. You'll also get ownership of a primary product area and the opportunity to see your research translate into real product improvements.



WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

 - Understand our users: Conduct user interviews, surveys and usability studies with developers, PMs and founders to understand their needs, behaviours and challenges.

 - Improve product experiences: Research user journeys across Sarvam's developer console, playground, API documentation and applications. Identify friction points across onboarding, API key creation, first API calls, billing and other key workflows.

 - Study developer journeys: Analyse the developer funnel, from sign-up to making the first API call and eventually becoming a paying user. Understand where users drop off and, more importantly, why.

 - Test and evaluate designs: Conduct usability testing on existing interfaces and new prototypes, run preference and A/B tests, and benchmark experiences against other developer products.

 - Turn research into insights: Analyse qualitative and quantitative data, identify patterns and present clear recommendations to product, design, growth and support teams.

 - Build the research practice: Help establish research playbooks, interview templates, participant recruitment processes and a research repository that can scale with the team.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong curiosity about user behaviour and a genuine interest in understanding why people use products the way they do.

 - Comfortable speaking with users, conducting interviews and asking thoughtful, unbiased questions.

 - Technical fluency — you should be comfortable reading API documentation, making basic API calls using tools like Postman, curl or Python, and understanding what might have gone wrong when an API fails.

 - Comfortable working with data, analysing spreadsheets and interpreting product funnels or dashboards.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate research findings into clear insights and recommendations.

 - Familiarity with AI tools and developer products, and an interest in exploring how they can improve research workflows.


GOOD TO HAVE

 - Experience with SQL or product analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude or Metabase.

 - Familiarity with user research methodologies, usability testing and survey design.

 - Experience reviewing Figma prototypes or conducting user interviews.

 - Previous research projects, internships or personal projects involving products you've built or shipped.

 - Fluency in one or more Indian languages.


WHO CAN APPLY?

 - Final-year students or graduates who have completed their studies within the last 12 months.

 - Candidates from engineering, psychology, economics, design or social science backgrounds.

 - Individuals who can commit to a full-time, 6-month, in-office internship in Bengaluru.


WHAT YOU'LL GET

 - The opportunity to help build Sarvam's user research function from the ground up.

 - Direct exposure to product, design and engineering teams working on India's sovereign AI ecosystem.

jobs.description:
Headquarters: California; New York; Remote - Colorado; Remote - Georgia; Remote - Ohio; Remote - Oregon; Remote - Pennsylvania; Remote - Texas; Remote - Washington; Remote - Washington D.C.
GAQ327R240

We're building a finance function that stays ahead of the curve — maximizing self-serve AI capabilities while driving an AI-first automation roadmap to operate at the pace Databricks demands. The Accounting Manager, Accounts Receivable, will serve as a senior individual contributor owning end-to-end technical AR accounting across global AR balances and multiple legal entities, leading multi-entity subledger consolidations as our global footprint expands. Working within a structured preparer/reviewer framework in close partnership with the broader Order-to-Cash (OTC), Revenue, and Finance Transformation teams, this high-ownership role bridges technical accounting rigor with cross-functional operational scale.
Close quality, accurate management reporting, and subledger integrity are non-negotiable. Success in this role requires both strong operational execution and sound technical accounting judgment - applying U.S. GAAP to complex global receivables matters, bad debt modeling, and close accruals to ensure an audit-ready subledger. You will own a high-quality close today while directly shaping how our global receivables accounting operates tomorrow, using an AI-first automation mindset to scale our processes alongside rapid company growth.
The impact you will have:

• Own the Global AR Month-End Close: Autonomously lead the monthly close cycle for Global AR balances, preparing end-to-end subledger-to-GL reconciliations, roll-forward schedules, unbilled revenue, deferred revenue adjustments, contra-AR, complex close accruals, and AR management reporting with clear analysis of material movements and key drivers.

• Technical Accounting & AFDA Modeling: Own the Allowance for Doubtful Accounts (AFDA) and Current Expected Credit Loss (CECL) accounting models; assess underlying assumptions and portfolio trends, prepare monthly provision recommendations, process approved write-offs with full audit trails, and ensure technical U.S. GAAP compliance

• Lead AI & Automation Adoption: Lead the identification, design, and adoption of AI and automation opportunities across AR accounting workflows, leveraging Databricks, LLMs, and advanced analytics to automate manual reconciliations, improve accrual accuracy, strengthen controls, and accelerate period closes.

• Maintain Balance Sheet Integrity: Own AR subledger integrity, flux analyses, variance explanations, and period-over-period movement schedules, providing clear management insights into AR trends, material movements, and key balance sheet drivers for senior Finance leadership.

• Drive Audit Readiness & SOX Controls: Maintain audit-ready workpapers and process documentation; serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external auditors regarding AR schedules, walkthroughs, and audit request responses.

• Cross-Functional Process Alignment: Partner with Billing Operations, Cash Applications, Revenue Assurance, Revenue Accounting, Corporate Accounting, and FP&A teams to validate subledger accuracy, clear unapplied balances, and reconcile AR balances.

• Finance Transformation & SAP Implementation: Partner with our Transformation, Engineering, and IT teams to redesign AR accounting workflows, eliminate manual routines, and drive process standardization, automation, testing, and data readiness for SAP and other systems implementations.

What we look for:

• Experience: 6+ years of progressive AR and GL accounting experience in a mid-to-large organization, with demonstrated ownership of month-end close, AFDA/CECL, subledger-to-GL reconciliations, and AR management reporting.

• Credentials: CPA strongly preferred. Bachelor's Degree in Accounting or Finance.

• Technical Accounting: Strong U.S. GAAP judgment and ability to independently research, document, and defend accounting conclusions relating to receivables, revenue recognition alignment, accrual cut-off, contract assets/liabilities, and expected credit loss methodologies.

• Autonomy & Review Readiness: Proven ability to operate independently with high autonomy, producing clean, reviewer-ready workpapers within a preparer/reviewer/approver framework.

• Systems & ERP: Hands-on ERP experience (SAP, NetSuite, or similar) with the ability to query, reconcile, and validate data across subledger and GL modules.

• M&A & Integration Experience: Prior experience supporting the accounting workstream of an acquisition is a strong plus. Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-moving integration environments with evolving data, processes, and systems is essential.

• The Automation Mindset: Advanced Excel proficiency (Power Query, dynamic arrays) paired with hands-on experience deploying or evaluating AI tools in a finance context; familiarity with data platforms like Databricks is a strong plus.

• Ownership & Mindset: High ownership, detail-oriented, fast-moving, direct communicator, and calm under pressure. Open-minded and change-oriented.

• Scale & Agility: High-growth technology or SaaS industry experience strongly preferred; exposure to recurring or usage-based billing models is an advantage. Public accounting background preferred.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager (Mexico)
jobs.description:
Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:
As a Samsara Technical Account Manager (TAM), you are the cornerstone of technical customer success. In this role, you will act as a trusted technical advisor, moving beyond traditional support to deliver measurable business value and drive the long-term adoption of the Samsara platform. Your mission is to proactively optimize your customers' technical health and mitigate risk, ensuring they achieve their desired outcomes.
This requires a unique blend of deep technical acumen, consultative problem-solving, and the ability to communicate with influence across both technical and executive stakeholders. You will build enduring customer relationships by translating their operational goals into powerful technical solutions. As the primary technical interface for your accounts, you will foster cross-functional collaboration with our Sales, Support, and Product teams to champion your customers' needs. During critical incidents, you will demonstrate ownership by managing customer communications and expectations through to a successful resolution.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in Mexico.

You should apply if:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

• You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.

• You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.

• You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

• Drive Customer Impact & Value Realization: Go beyond technical support to consistently deliver measurable value. You will develop a deep understanding of your customers' business objectives and proactively align Samsara's solutions to help them achieve their goals, tracking and demonstrating technical ROI along the way.

• Use AI to Transform the Customer Experience: Leverage AI-powered tools and insights to anticipate customer needs, personalize engagement, and deliver faster, more proactive, and impactful outcomes.

• Execute Transformational Technical Account Management: Independently manage a portfolio of accounts, developing tailored success plans and identifying and mitigating risks to customer health. You will maintain accurate records of customer interactions and contribute to team-wide objectives.

• Demonstrate Deep Technical Acumen & Samsara Expertise: Be the primary technical point of contact, mastering Samsara's platform, including APIs, hardware, and software. You will advise customers on best practices and troubleshoot complex technical issues with proficiency.

• Provide Consultative Problem Solving & Solutioning: Employ a consultative approach to understand the root cause of customer challenges. You will own the technical ticket lifecycle, including technical escalations from report to resolution, and conduct root cause analysis to prevent recurrence and drive product improvement.

• Communicate with Influence and Clarity: Lead customer meetings, from technical deep dives to quarterly technical account reviews, with confidence. You will adapt your communication style to effectively engage with diverse audiences, from technical staff to non-technical executives.

• Foster Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner effectively with Sales, Support, Product, and Engineering teams to advocate for customer needs and deliver a unified experience.

• Demonstrate Ownership and Act as a Multiplier: Embody a 'get it done' mentality by taking initiative on team projects and process improvements. You will actively contribute to our internal knowledge base and help onboard new team members, sharing best practices to enhance the entire team's capabilities.

• Embody Samsara's Values & Principles: Consistently champion and role model Samsara's core values and operating principles in every interaction, actively seeking feedback for continuous improvement

Minimum requirements for the role:

• Experience: 7+ years experience in a technical, customer-facing role such as technical account management, solutions consulting, or customer success, with a demonstrated track record of success.

• Education: We welcome applications from candidates with a bachelor's degree in a technical field, or those who have gained equivalent expertise through practical experience in areas such as Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields.

• Technical Proficiency: Exceptional technical literacy with the ability to understand and troubleshoot complex hardware, software, and API integrations. A strong passion for technology and a commitment to continuous learning, including an interest in AI and its applications.

• Bilingual: English and Spanish is a must.

• Customer Focus: A data-informed approach to understanding customer needs and a demonstrated ability to build trusted, long-term relationships.

• Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish is required.

• Collaborative Spirit: A team player who thrives in a fast-paced environment and works effectively with internal teams to drive customer success.

An ideal candidate also has:

• Experience supporting global enterprise-level customers in a SaaS, IoT, or PaaS environment.

• Proven experience leveraging AI tools and methodologies in daily workflows to drive efficiency, generate customer insights, and improve overall customer success.

• Prior experience with Samsara, Salesforce, Zendesk, Jira, Gong, Gainsight, and Tableau.

• Basic Python coding skills are an asset for providing enhanced technical solutions

Total Rewards
At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
Flexible Working
At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.
Belonging at Samsara
At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.
Accommodations
Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.
Our Commitment to Authenticity
We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co.
