jobs.title: Specialist Solutions Architect, Billing
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team
Specialist Solutions Architects (SSA) are domain experts aligned to specific Stripe solutions and customer buying centers. We have in-depth knowledge of specific solution offerings and a deep understanding of customer challenges. We align with specialist product sellers on deals, advise the broader pre-sales team on complex opportunities, support pipeline development and revenue attainment, serve as an advisor on go-to-market sales plays, and provide critical insights to our product and engineering teams.

What you’ll do
You will collaborate closely with sales and pre-sales teams to drive pipeline and revenue targets, while also educating the product and engineering teams on market trends and strongly influencing the product roadmap. You will develop deep relationships with senior customer business leaders and grow Stripe's solution offerings with new and existing customers. As a subject matter expert, you will scale the broader organization by creating reusable assets and coaching others on complex, high-value opportunities.
The team is looking for a Revenue and Finance Automation specialist with a deep understanding of the order-to-cash process and how modern businesses manage subscription billing, invoicing, and revenue recognition. You will engage with customers as a thought leader in the billing infrastructure space, helping them design solutions on Stripe Billing that reduce churn, improve cash collection, and align their financial operations with accurate revenue recognition under GAAP/IFRS standards.

Responsibilities

• Act as a subject matter expert on Stripe's Billing, Invoicing, and Revenue Recognition products to accelerate opportunities

• Demonstrate a deep understanding of the order-to-cash process—including subscription and usage-based billing, dunning, proration, and revenue recognition workflows—and how these map to Stripe's platform

• Conduct deep discovery of customers' existing billing architecture and business model to architect solutions that align Stripe's capabilities with their quote-to-cash requirements

• Advise customers on how to design for complexity: mid-cycle upgrades, entitlement management, multi-currency revenue recognition, and integration with ERP systems (NetSuite, Workday, SAP)

• Create and share best practices and reusable assets such as reference architectures to enhance the quality and efficiency of the broader sales and pre-sales organizations

• Partner closely with the Billing product sales team and actively drive opportunities for Stripe's largest customers, leading solution strategy and owning key customer relationships

• Serve as a "Voice of the Customer" to drive product and feature request prioritization

• Identify product, industry, implementation, and competitive trends, and provide actionable insights to product stakeholders and sales to influence Stripe's billing product roadmap

• Act as an escalation point to drive complex technical issues to resolution with Stripe's engineering team

• Represent the technical health of the business on quarterly sales forecast calls and highlight deal blockers with proposed solutions

• Support marketing events including executive briefings, conferences, user groups, and trade shows

Who you are
We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 7+ years of experience in a technical sales, pre-sales, or solutions architecture role, with a focus on billing, subscription, or revenue management platforms

• 3+ years of hands-on experience with the order-to-cash process in a SaaS environment, including subscription lifecycle management, dunning, and revenue recognition

• Strong understanding of revenue recognition standards (ASC 606, IFRS 15) and how they apply to SaaS and usage-based business models

• Experience working with or implementing billing and ERP software (NetSuite, Workday, SAP, Zuora, BillingPlatform, or similar)

• Strong knowledge of software engineering and API integration patterns

• Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, comfortable explaining complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

• A proven ability to build strong collaborative working relationships with business partners

• Ability to deal effectively with ambiguity and thrive in an unstructured, fast-moving environment

Preferred qualifications

• Experience integrating Stripe or other RESTful APIs into web applications

• Familiarity with complex billing scenarios: usage-based pricing, tiered models, multi-entity revenue recognition, or hybrid subscription and consumption models

• Experience with CRM platforms and their integration with billing systems

• Experience as a subject matter expert in a relevant industry, vertical, or product

Atlan is building the context layer for enterprise AI. Enterprises are pouring money into AI and most of it dies in production because the AI does not understand the business context around the data. That is the problem Atlan solves.

Please note: This is an India-based role supporting a North America regional pod, with working hours aligned to NA business hours (7pm–4am IST).



What you will do

 - Own pipeline creation inside a regional pod in North America with a shared BDR and AE target, ensuring every high-intent lead is worked quickly, every account is multithreaded intelligently, and no coverage gap slows the pod down.

 - Build a disciplined outbound motion from the ground up, researching accounts, identifying the right stakeholders, and crafting outreach that earns a reply because it is specific and relevant, not because a sequence fired it.

 - Qualify with precision, confirming pain, need, timeline, and authority before booking, so every S1 the pod conducts is worth conducting.

 - Operate as the bridge between marketing and sales in your pod, keeping meetings, follow-up, and account coverage consistent across inbound, outbound, and events.

 - Build workflows, agents, or systems that make you measurably faster and better over time, not just more active.
   
   

What makes you a match

 - You have at least 2 years of BDR or SDR experience in SaaS, with a track record of building outbound pipeline, not just managing inbound volume. You know the difference and it shows in how you talk about your work.

 - You qualify rigorously, multithread naturally, and treat personalization as a non-negotiable, not a nice-to-have. You do the diligence before the first touch, not after the first no.

 - You are fluent in Salesforce, Outreach or a comparable sequencing tool, and Sales Navigator. You are curious about what Clay and adjacent GTM tooling can do for your workflow.

 - AI-native: you use AI by default and have already started redesigning how you work around it, not just using it to write emails faster. You know the difference between AI assisting your workflow and AI changing it.

 - You have a technical background, whether through a degree in engineering, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience, that lets you hold your own in conversations with data engineers, analytics leaders, and technical buyers.

 - You reset quickly when the motion shifts, take feedback without friction, and hold yourself to a daily standard that does not depend on your leader to enforce it.
   
   




WHY ATLAN?

Joining Atlan means being part of a global movement to help data teams do their life’s best work. Here’s what you can expect:

 - Competitive Compensation:  We benchmark at the top of the market and keep compensation simple: strong base salary, performance‑based variable pay, and impact‑driven equity (for most roles), so your total rewards grow in step with the value you create over time.

 - AI Native Culture: Atlan is where AI-native builders come to build the systems the future of work will run on. AI isn’t an add-on, it’s woven into how we build, think, and work every day, empowering every Atlanian to move faster and create a bigger impact.

 - Health & Wellness: From Day‑1 health, dental, vision, and mental health to flexible health stipends, we design benefits offerings that lead in each country we're in.

 - Flexible Time Off & Leave Policies: We trust you to own your energy: flexible time off and modern leave so you can unplug properly, support yourself and your loved ones, and come back ready to drive an impact.

 - Accelerated Growth & Learning: Develop at an uncommon velocity through cutting-edge tech, complex implementations, and an experienced team that values mastery.

 - Global, Remote-First, High-Trust:  Work from anywhere with a diverse team across 15+ countries, in a trust-first, async environment that gives you true flexibility and ownership over how you work.



More About Us

Atlan is building the shared context layer that enterprises need so AI can operate on trusted, governed context. The conversation has moved from data leaders asking:  “Can we trust the data in our stack?” to businesses asking: “Can we trust AI inside the business?”

We are the missing infrastructure for businesses becoming AI-forward - the connective tissue between their data stack, operational systems, and AI agents.

How do we work?
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.

Be a bridger
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.

Care loudly
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.

Own the outcome
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.

About DevRev
At DevRev, we're building the future of work with Computer – your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools, Computer unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.

Job Description
We are an untraditional SaaS revenue organization, built to support a rapidly scaling technology start-up driven by product-led-growth and sales (PLG / PLS). Specific responsibilities for account executives include nurturing larger named accounts & enterprise customers - who are looking for a better way to connect with their customers and find product market fit. You will work closely with customers end-to-end throughout their lifecycle - from concept to technical requirements, implementation, adoption, expansion, and paid. This is truly an expansive sales responsibility that spans selling, success, and support. Activities related to this role will, for example, include:

• Build outreach to existing rolodex and new opportunities.

• Relentless manage customer followup and your own pipeline, against quotas.

• Work with our Growth team to increase product awareness.

• Nurture and follow up with customers to share relevant use cases, find key decision makers, and gather requirements.

• Guide customers through implementation plans to further adoption and drive paid conversion.

• Work with our Product and Engineering to share feedback and feature requests.

• Create content and refine scripts to support the customer journey and engagement points.

• Maintain pipeline data and account information in DevRev's in-house CRM.

Ideal Candidate Qualifications:

• New Business Development Skills: Demonstrated ability to identify and pursue new business opportunities, including prospecting, cold calling, and networking to generate leads and expand the customer base.

• Entrepreneurial Spirit: A proactive and innovative approach to sales, with a mindset focused on growth, creativity, and taking ownership of outcomes. This includes a willingness to experiment with new strategies and approaches to achieve sales targets.

• Strategic Thinker: Capable of developing and executing strategic sales plans that align with company objectives and market trends. This involves analyzing market data, identifying growth opportunities, and adapting tactics accordingly.

• Autonomous and Self-Motivated: Comfortable working independently and taking initiative to drive sales initiatives forward. This includes being self-motivated to meet and exceed sales targets without constant supervision.

• Passion and Commitment: Demonstrates a strong passion for the product and industry, coupled with a commitment to delivering exceptional customer service and building long-term relationships.

• Risk-Taker and Resilient: Willingness to embrace risk and overcome setbacks with resilience. Ideal candidate embodies founder's mentality, often entails a high tolerance for ambiguity and the ability to navigate uncertainty.

• Customer-Centric Approach: Prioritizes understanding customer needs and providing tailored solutions that add value and drive customer satisfaction.

• Innovative Problem Solver: Ability to think creatively to address customer challenges and differentiate the company's offerings in a competitive market.

• Leadership Potential: Exhibits leadership qualities such as vision, influence, and the ability to inspire and motivate others toward shared goals.

The ideal candidate drives immediate sales but also contributes to the overall growth and success of the business through their entrepreneurial mindset and strategic thinking.
As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV.

How do we work?
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.

Be a bridger
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.

Care loudly
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.

Own the outcome
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.

That’s DevRev!

job.title: Escalation Engineer
job.description:
Headquarters: Remote, United States

Category-defining tech. Career-defining work.
For more than a decade, Cockroach Labs has built database technology trusted to power some of the world's most mission-critical applications. Now, as AI transforms how software is created and operated, the infrastructure behind it has to keep pace. Cockroach Continuum is built to meet this moment, bringing individual databases together into one fleet designed for agentic applications, where AI agents help teams provision, scale, and optimize workloads at machine speed.
The customers you'll work with are some of the most innovative businesses in the world, and the problems they're trying to solve are real and urgent. You'll bring a genuinely differentiated product to a market moving fast, at a company positioned to lead it. The people who thrive here are the ones who want to own that opportunity.

The Role
We're looking for an Escalation Engineer to join the Cockroach Labs Technical Support team in the AMER region. You will be the escalation point for the most challenging customer issues: reviewing, assisting with, or taking over cases that need more expertise or oversight, and driving resolution with other departments. You are expected to work with a high level of autonomy and resolve complex issues quickly.
This is a remote role open to candidates in the Pacific or Mountain time zone, as the team operates in Pacific time zone hours.

You Will

• Provide advanced support to customers and front-line technical support engineers to diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex issues via CRM, Slack, video chat, and/or remote access.

• Act as a point of escalation for tickets with no clear path to resolution where the Technical Support team has exhausted available tools and processes.

• Identify when a ticket or account requires additional support and act proactively to course correct.

• Use AI-assisted tooling in your investigations, including log and debug-bundle analysis, reproduction scaffolding, and code reading, and verify its output before it reaches a customer or an engineer.

• Evaluate how escalations could have been avoided, and contribute to process, tooling, and observability improvements that reduce escalations and time to resolution, including where AI tooling could help.

• Provide training and mentorship to junior support staff, sharing knowledge and expertise to help them handle complex issues more effectively.

• Share effective AI workflows with the team, and help front-line engineers learn where AI output is reliable and where it needs independent verification.

• Maintain detailed and accurate documentation of ongoing cases, including steps taken, findings, and proposed solutions.

• Advocate for the customer within the organization, ensuring that their concerns are understood and addressed appropriately.

• Participate in on-call and shift rotations with transfer of cases to other geographic regions in a “follow the sun” methodology.

• Stay updated on new features, technologies, and best practices related to the products or services supported.

The Expectations
In your first 30 days, you'll learn CockroachDB, our customers, and our company through a self-guided onboarding platform of reading and hands-on exercises. By the end of the month, you'll be assisting customers directly.
After 3 months, you'll be fully integrated into the team and will be familiar with the various systems we use. You'll be able to manage most issues from customers and will be able to contribute to improving the scope and quality of our offerings. As our team and your expertise grow, you’ll begin mentoring and training new members of the team, developing and updating training and documentation to ensure that knowledge is not lost.

You Have

• 7+ years of experience working in Technical Support or a similar technical role at a software company.

• Strong knowledge of databases and the ability to read and write SQL.

• Knowledge of distributed systems, Linux, and an understanding of software development.

• Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, including root cause analysis, in a global 24x7x365 environment.

• Experience using AI tools to troubleshoot and diagnose technical issues, an understanding of their common failure modes, and the judgment to verify their output before relying on it.

• A customer-first approach to critical thinking.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, including adjusting tone and content for technical and non-technical audiences, and a passion for working with users directly.

• The polish expected when working with Fortune 500 enterprise customers.

• Familiarity with, or willingness to learn, the technologies behind enterprise applications.

• The ability to absorb information. You love getting into the weeds technically, but don't let that distract you from achieving your goals.

• The ability to participate in a weekend on-call rotation.

Cockroach Labs is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you need additional accommodations to feel comfortable during your interview process, please email us at accessibility@cockroachlabs.com .
Cockroach Labs has a hybrid work model, with Roachers that are local to one of our offices coming in on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays and working flexibly the rest of the week. While we’ve learned valuable lessons working remotely, nothing can replace the connection, creativity, and fun that occurs when Roachers get together and we are committed to fostering a workplace that encourages collaboration and allows us all to do our best work.

Benefits

• Stock Options

• Medical Insurance

• Life and Disability Insurance

• Professional Development Funds

• Flexible Time Off

• Paid Holidays

• Paid Sick Days

• Paid Parental Leave

• Retirement Benefits

• Mental Wellbeing Benefits

• And more!

The annual anticipated base salary range for candidates for this role is listed below. Salary is one component of the Cockroach Labs’ Total Rewards package, which also includes: stock options, medical insurance, vision insurance, dental insurance, life and disability insurance, funds for professional development, flexible paid time off, paid sick days and holidays, paid parental leave, and wellbeing benefits. We have a match on 401(k) contributions in the U.S.
We set competitive pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and geographic location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Benefits programs are designed according to local market practices. Actual salaries may vary and fall outside of this range depending on factors such as a candidate’s qualifications, geographic location, skills, experience, and competencies. In addition, we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted.

job.title: Lead-to-Cash Business Partner
job.description:
Headquarters: Remote United States
BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio.
Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself.
The Role
We are seeking a Lead-to-Cash Business Partner to support and continuously improve our Salesforce-enabled Lead-to-Cash processes across various business areas such as Revenue Operations, Finance, Quote to Order, Order to Cash, and Customer Success to surface and understand business needs, define well-scoped enhancement requests, and drive improvements through a structured Lead-to-Cash governance model.
This is an individual contributor role that sits at the intersection of business process, system governance, and analytical rigor. The ideal candidate brings strong discovery instincts, a genuine curiosity for root cause problem-solving, and the ability to challenge and sharpen business asks before they enter the delivery pipeline. Salesforce familiarity, business judgment, strong interpersonal skills, and requirements rigor are the core of this role.
What You’ll Do
Business Partnership & Discovery

• Partner with business stakeholders across assigned workstreams to understand current-state challenges, process friction, and desired outcomes

• Apply strong discovery discipline to go beyond what stakeholders ask for to diagnose root cause, clarify the true business problem, and influence and advise on the solution path

• Challenge and refine business asks with intellectual curiosity and a solutions-oriented mindset, ensuring requests are grounded in measurable outcomes rather than assumed solutions

• Build trusted relationships across the business areas

Enhancement Definition & Intake

• Conduct initial intake review of submitted enhancement requests, assessing completeness, strategic alignment, and impact to translate findings into well-structured business justifications with defined outcomes and success metrics

• Ensure requests account for end-to-end process and system impacts before progressing through the governance process

• Incorporate bugs alongside enhancements in business lead conversations to build a holistic, impact-driven prioritization view across all request types.

Technical Review & Effort Estimation Support

• Use HLE outputs to rationalize business value against estimated complexity, supporting informed prioritization decisions before requests enter the SF Solutioning queue

• Collaborate with other L2C Business Partners on technically complex requests to ensure solution approach considerations are surfaced early

Salesforce CoE Partnership & Delivery Support

• Act as a business process partner to the Salesforce CoE

• Collaborate with the SF CoE on requirements clarification, solution validation, and prioritization

• Ensure delivered solutions align with defined business outcomes and original success criteria

Documentation, Governance & Communication

• Maintain Business area-level process documentation and L2C artifacts

• Communicate enhancement and prioritization decisions, roadmap updates, and Salesforce releases to Business Leads in clear, non-technical language

• Translate technical changes into business-focused messaging that supports stakeholder adoption

Continuous Improvement

• Monitor Lead-to-Cash process feedback and workstream health to proactively identify improvement opportunities

• Recommend system and process enhancements that improve efficiency, data quality, and scalability across the L2C process

• Approach every aspect of the role with an AI-first mindset. Continuously identifying and applying AI capabilities to improve how the L2C team operates and how BeyondTrust’s systems, processes, and enhancements are evaluated, defined, and delivered

What You’ll Bring

• 4–7 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Business Systems, Sales Operations, or a related role with direct exposure to Salesforce-enabled processes

• Strong discovery and requirements skills—demonstrated ability to dig beneath surface-level requests, identify root cause, and define the real problem before recommending a solution

• Solid understanding of Lead-to-Cash processes including lead management, opportunity management, quoting, contracting, and order management

• Hands-on familiarity with Salesforce in a B2B environment

• Proven ability to build relationships with business stakeholders and influence prioritization decisions without direct authority

• Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complexity into clear, stakeholder-ready language

• Demonstrated curiosity and initiative in exploring AI tools, with a track record of finding meaningful ways to incorporate them into day-to-day work

Nice To Have

• Experience in SaaS or cybersecurity organizations

• Exposure to Salesforce CPQ and GTM Tools

• Background in consulting, technical product management, or business process architecture

• Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery models and working alongside a Salesforce Center of Excellence

Better Together

We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.

BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. job.title: Accounting Manager
job.description:
Headquarters: Remote US
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Finance team
The Finance team ensures Affirm remains financially sound and strategically positioned for growth. Our team manages financial planning, accounting, pricing, vendor management, tax, investor relations, and corporate development. We deliver timely insights, accurate reporting, and careful analysis to support decision-making. From day-to-day financial operations to major investments, we enable sustainable, informed growth by maintaining strong fiscal discipline.

About the role
Affirm is looking for an experienced Accounting Manager to support and manage our international accounting operations, with a focus on statutory accounting, statutory audits, financial statement preparation, local compliance requirements, transfer pricing, and monthly close activities.
In this role, you will help ensure Affirm’s international entities are supported by accurate books and records, timely close execution, audit-ready documentation, and compliant local reporting. You will coordinate closely with internal Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Payroll, People, Finance, Technical Accounting and Financial Reporting teams, as well as external auditors, accounting firms, tax advisors, and statutory service providers.
You will bring strong US GAAP and local statutory accounting awareness, excellent project management skills, and the ability to manage multiple workstreams across jurisdictions. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, highly organized, proactive, and comfortable driving work through cross-functional partners and external providers.
You will be expected to deliver reliable, high-quality results, communicate clearly, and improve processes that make statutory accounting, audit support, and transfer pricing activities more scalable over time. You are a strong problem solver and communicator who is excited to support Affirm’s continued growth and mission to deliver honest financial products that improve lives.

What you’ll do

• Manage statutory accounting and monthly close activities for international entities, including journal entries, accruals, reconciliations, variance analysis, and close checklist completion.

• Coordinate with external accounting, payroll, tax, statutory, and audit providers to ensure accurate local books, timely deliverables, and compliance with local requirements.

• Lead statutory audit planning and execution, including auditor onboarding, timelines, status tracking, request management, issue resolution, and stakeholder coordination.

• Prepare and review statutory financial statements, disclosures, footnotes, supporting schedules, and tie-outs to trial balances, reconciliations, and audit evidence.

• Own PBC coordination and audit testing support by gathering, validating, reviewing, and submitting accurate and complete audit documentation.

• Partner with Technical Accounting, Financial Reporting, Tax, Legal, Treasury, Payroll, People, Finance, and external advisors on local accounting requirements, statutory adjustments, and reporting matters.

• Manage audit completion and filing activities, including open item resolution, final approvals, signed documents, filing coordination, and completed audit file retention.

• Own or support transfer pricing calculations, intercompany invoicing, related journal entries, reconciliations, settlements, and cross-functional alignment.

• Review trial balances, general ledger activity, reconciliations, and financial statement variances to identify risks, unusual items, required adjustments, and recurring issues.

• Strengthen process improvements and controls across statutory accounting and audit workflows by standardizing templates, improving review checklists, clarifying ownership, documenting key judgments, enhancing audit trails, and building repeatable processes that reduce manual effort, improve accuracy, and support audit readiness.

• Identify control gaps, process inefficiencies, and documentation weaknesses; partner with stakeholders to implement scalable solutions, improve close governance, and ensure processes remain effective as entities, requirements, and reporting complexity evolve.

• Use systems and tools such as NetSuite, Blackline, Excel, Workday, and AI-enabled workflows to improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.

What we look for

• CPA professional accounting designation; or 6+ years of relevant professional accounting experience with a bachelor’s degree in business or finance.

• Public accounting experience preferred, especially audit experience with multinational or public company clients.

• Strong knowledge of US GAAP, statutory accounting, financial statement preparation, account reconciliations, journal entries, and month-end close.

• Experience supporting or managing statutory audits, including PBC coordination, audit testing, financial statement review, audit completion, and filing.

• Experience working with international entities, local accounting requirements, statutory reporting, and external service providers.

• Experience with transfer pricing calculations, intercompany invoicing, intercompany reconciliations, and cross-border accounting activity.

• Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple audits, deadlines, entities, and stakeholders at once.

• Excellent attention to detail and ability to produce accurate, complete, audit-ready work under tight timelines.

• Ability to partner effectively with Technical Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Payroll, People, Finance, external auditors, and local accounting providers.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain audit status, accounting issues, risks, and recommendations clearly.

• Advanced Excel skills, including lookups, conditional formulas, pivot tables, large dataset analysis, and financial statement support.

• Experience with accounting systems and close management tools; NetSuite and Blackline experience preferred.

• Strong ownership mindset and desire to improve processes, reduce manual work, and make accounting workflows more scalable over time.

• Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment with competing priorities.

Base Pay Grade - K
Equity Grade - 6
Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.
Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)
USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $ 145,000 - $ 205,000
USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $ 128,000 - $ 188,000

All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.
Benefits designed for you
Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

job.title: Senior Customer Success Manager
job.description:
Headquarters: US - Remote
Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.

Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

Our vision: A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.

About the Role:
You'll own your outcomes, from the strategies you run to the conversations that shape what we build next. As a Senior Customer Success Manager at Wrike, you will own, protect, and exponentially grow the strategic relationship for a high-value portfolio of Enterprise accounts across North America. Wrike has evolved beyond standard project management into a trusted work delivery platform for people and AI, and in this role, you will be the chief architect of that vision for our most strategic clients.
In this role, you are a strategic business consultant and a trusted advisor. You will guide client executives through complex business transformations, leveraging cutting-edge Wrike AI Agents, Wrike Copilot, and visual collaboration tools to map, optimize, and scale business workflows. You will partner deeply with Sales, Renewals, and Product counterparts to deliver on the transformational vision and establish Wrike as the clients' long-term operating system of record.

Your Impact:

• Strategic Portfolio Ownership: Proactively manage a highly diverse and complex book of North American Enterprise accounts, serving as their strategic partner, executive liaison, and primary advocate.

• Build Stakeholder Relationships: Establish a multi-layered relationship structure - including Centers of Excellence - connecting with administrators, day-to-day champions, and executive-level sponsors (VPs, C-suite).

• Co-Create Success Plans & Workflows: Build scalable and highly digestible Success Plans that capture the client's transformational vision and a measurable roadmap to build it out.

• Play Offense: Actively hunt for expansion paths within your portfolio. You will not wait for renewals to talk about growth; instead, you will proactively identify new teams to land, pitch advanced AI use cases, and systematically build a high-velocity expansion pipeline in lockstep with Sales.

• Commercial Growth & Retention: Meet individual Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) and Net Revenue Retention (NRR) targets by proactively identifying expansion opportunities, mapping customer growth plans, and mitigating churn risks early.

• Operational Excellence: You will continuously iterate on processes, develop new workflow playbooks, and share documented learnings across the broader organization.

Your Qualifications:

• Proven GTM Track Record: 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Business Consulting roles within the SaaS space, with a verified track record of managing $100K+ ARR accounts.

• Change Management & COE Mastery: Proven expertise in guiding large-scale organizations through complex software rollouts and operational transformations by mapping and navigating stakeholder management and building internal Centers of Excellence (COEs).

• Executive Presence & Storytelling: Highly polished communication skills with a proven capability to establish radical trust, navigate political dynamics, and present quantified business value/ROI to C-suite and VP-level technology leaders.

• Commercial Acumen & C-Suite Framing: A proven history of partnering with Sales to build joint account plans, identify upsell opportunities, and guide customers through complex buying cycles. You possess a deep understanding of enterprise procurement processes and are highly skilled at framing the business and operational value of a product to C-level audiences, translating technical features into hard cost savings, risk mitigation, and operational efficiency.

• Workflow Consulting Expertise: Ability to run structured, outcome-led Workflow Discoveries and reverse demos to help customers work collaboratively across dispersed organizations and recommend best practices.

• Technical & Integration Literacy: Strong comfort with tech ecosystems; ability to discuss complex system integrations, data analytics, and address technical hurdles (such as API webhooks or integration recipes) in lockstep with supporting teams.

• AI-Enabled Capability: Strong literacy and hands-on experience embedding practical Generative AI tools into daily operations.

Standout Qualities:

• Vertical Specialization: You have deep domain expertise in one or more core industry verticals (e.g., Marketing, Creative Agencies, PMOs) and can build reusable workflow playbooks for the team.

• Certified Change Management Coach: You have experience guiding organizations through large-scale software rollouts and operational change management.

• Certified Project Manager: You hold a recognized industry certification (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile/Scrum) and possess a formal understanding of project management methodologies to easily translate complex client workflows into structured, high-performing configurations.

• Peer Mentor: You naturally seek opportunities to mentor junior team members, share best practices, and contribute to the collective enablement of the Customer Success organization.

• Utilize Digital Campaign: You have the ability to leverage digital campaigns to target new contacts and opportunities.

Team Dynamics:
You will join a high-performing, collaborative North American Customer Success team that values transparency, continuous learning, and collective growth. We work cross-functionally, sharing insights across Sales, Product, Renewals, and Support to ensure our customers have a unified experience. As a senior member of this team, you will play a key role in running internal enablement sessions and shaping best practices.

Our Work Style:
At Wrike, we believe in proactive ownership, data-driven decisions, and a growth mindset. We leverage Wrike every day to manage our own work, collaborate seamlessly across time zones, and maintain operational transparency. We embrace change, continuously seek feedback, and empower our team members to work smart, innovate, and bring their authentic selves to work every day.

Benefits & Perks:

• Flexible Time Off (FTO)

• Company 401(k) Match

• Parental Leave: 18 Weeks Maternity / 4 Week Paternity

• 2 Volunteer Days

• Disability (STD, LTD) & Life Insurance Plans (2x Salary, Capped)

• Working from Home Allowance ($40 / Monthly)

• $500 Working from Home home office set-up Stipend

job.title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager, Paid Social
job.description:
Headquarters: Atlanta, GA - Hybrid; Burlingame, CA - Hybrid; Denver, CO - Hybrid; New York, NY - Hybrid; San Francisco, CA - Hybrid; Scottsdale, AZ - Hybrid; Toronto, Ontario - Remote

About Gusto
At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.
All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy .
AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role
Gusto is looking for a seasoned performance marketer to own execution across paid social and emerging acquisition channels, testing new platforms, formats, and tactics to find what works before scaling. This is a high-visibility role at the intersection of performance marketing, channel experimentation, and AI-powered workflow design. You will own execution and day-to-day strategy for paid social and new channel tests, working within Gusto's demand generation framework, with clear accountability to pipeline and revenue targets.
About the Team
As a member of Gusto's Demand Generation team, you will be embedded specifically within Paid Acquisition, a focused group responsible for driving awareness and pipeline through paid media. This team operates with high autonomy, a bias for experimentation, and a culture of cross-functional partnership. We hold ourselves to a high standard, move fast, and genuinely believe that being AI-native is part of what it means to do this job well today.
Here's what you'll do day-to-day:

• Own paid social strategy and execution across Meta, LinkedIn, Reddit, Quora, and TikTok, driving full-funnel campaigns from brand awareness through retargeting and conversion, with accountability to pipeline and revenue targets.

• Manage significant, multi-million dollar budgets with rigor, including campaign pacing, forecasting, budget-vs-actuals analysis, and making the case for paid social investment in imperfect attribution environments.

• Apply and help refine Gusto's paid acquisition measurement framework, including attribution philosophy and budget allocation principles, in partnership with the broader marketing team. Collaborate with Engineering to launch new pixels and tracking, troubleshoot platform-side issues, and QA implementations, keeping measurement reliable as tracking needs evolve.

• Lead creative strategy and testing at scale: briefing creative studios and agencies, structuring meaningful experiments, interpreting complex data sets to drive actionable insights, and building a clear learning roadmap. Align with the Brand and Influencer team to run the organic-to-paid feedback loop: turning proven organic and influencer content into paid scale, and feeding results back to sharpen what earns that investment next.

• Use AI tools as a consistent, habitual part of your workflow: generating campaign briefs, developing copy variants, accelerating audience research, and building reusable systems that raise the bar for the whole team. Serve as the team's go-to expert on paid social and AI-powered marketing workflows, documenting playbooks and best practices for the paid acquisition team.

• Identify, test, and validate new digital media channels and formats beyond core paid social (such as Google Demand Generation campaigns and ChatGPT ads), running structured pilots, defining success criteria upfront, and making the call on scale vs. kill within existing budget guardrails.

• Partner cross-functionally with Integrated Marketing, Product Marketing, Sales, Communications, and Web to align paid social with integrated campaigns and earned media moments, and bring performance data back upstream to influence creative production and asset strategy. Partner with Web Marketing to align on landing page strategy, message match, and post-click conversion, because paid social performance doesn't end at the click.

Here's what we're looking for:

• 7+ years of performance marketing experience at a B2B SaaS, performance marketing agency, or high-growth consumer organization, with deep expertise in paid social and a track record of testing and scaling new channels.

• Full-funnel ownership across two or more major paid social platforms (Meta, LinkedIn, Reddit, Quora, TikTok), including deep, hands-on, in-platform execution (campaign builds, audience/targeting strategy, creative testing, bid/budget management), with significant budget responsibility and a track record of driving measurable pipeline impact.

• Strong creative strategy and testing instincts: you know how to structure a test, distinguish a learning from a result, and translate performance data into creative direction.

• AI-fluent in practice, not just in theory; you use AI tools consistently in your day-to-day workflow to accelerate briefs, copy, and analysis, and have a track record of implementing AI-driven efficiencies for your team.

• Excellent cross-functional collaborator who can translate integrated briefs into paid social strategy, advocate for what the channel needs, and work effectively alongside brand, web, and comms partners.

• You are analytical and data-driven, with a clear point of view on attribution in imperfect measurement environments and comfort communicating paid social's contribution to business outcomes.

Compensation
Our cash compensation amount for this role is targeted at $109,000 - $133,000/yr in Denver, and $132,000 - $161,000/yr for San Francisco and New York. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above.
At Gusto, we don't use titles the traditional way, as a signal of rank or hierarchy. Instead, our titles describe two things at once — your craft (what you do, e.g. Engineering, Design) and your scope of ownership (what you're accountable for) — which is why you'll see something like "Head of X" instead of a rank word like "Director" that tells you neither. Because of this, the title on this posting may look different from what you'd expect based on the scope and seniority of the role, and from how similar roles are typically titled elsewhere. If you have questions about how this role compares to your current title or level, your recruiter can help translate.
Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale.
Note: The San Francisco office expectations encompass both the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas.
When approved to work from a location other than a Gusto office, a secure, reliable, and consistent internet connection is required. This includes non-office days for hybrid employees.
Reliable, consistent presence: We expect regular and predictable attendance, whether you're working in-office, hybrid, or fully remote, so that you stay closely connected to your team, customers, and stakeholders in real time and ensure colleagues and customers receive the timely support and responsiveness they deserve.
Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Gusto.
Gusto is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Gusto considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Gusto is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. We want to see our candidates perform to the best of their ability. If you require a medical or religious accommodation at any time throughout your candidate journey, please fill out this form and a member of our team will get in touch with you.

job.description:
Headquarters: Atlanta, GA - Hybrid; Austin, TX - Remote; Chicago, IL - Remote; Denver, CO - Hybrid; Los Angeles, CA - Remote; Miami, FL - Remote; New York, NY - Hybrid; San Francisco, CA - Hybrid; Seattle, WA - Remote

About Gusto
At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.
All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy .
AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role:
We’re hiring seasoned engineers to join our teams that work on core platform capabilities, improving our existing systems for extensibility and scalability, and building the future of Gusto's Tax platform. As a Gusto Software Engineer at this level, you’ll be guiding projects end-to-end by influencing initial feature specs, understanding how to take existing systems closer to desired end states, executing on projects, and maintaining code that powers core experiences. If you’re interested in building elegant software with far-reaching effects in our modern economy, join us!

About the Team:
Payroll is the beating heart of Gusto’s business. The Tax team ensures Gusto customers remain compliant and confident by managing every aspect of payroll taxes—including setup, calculation, payments, filings, and year-end communications. We design seamless, end-to-end experiences that simplify complex processes and build the infrastructure that keeps taxes accurate and on time. By combining reliable systems with thoughtful design, our team makes one of the most complicated parts of running a business simple for employers. Tax is a stabilizing pace layer at Gusto: continuity and trust are paramount, change is deliberate, and impact is wide. The domain is highly complex and offers the opportunity to engage in system design that simplifies this for customers.
Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:

• Design, build, and test the platform that supports tax compliance for millions of people

• Help scale one of the largest Ruby/Rails and TypeScript/React applications in the world

• Collaborate on complex and ambiguous problems with partnerships from Engineering, Product Management, Design, Data Science, Compliance, Operations, and other cross-functional teams

• Improve the productivity and happiness of our teams with the services, tools, and APIs you build.

• Build guardrails into the Tax platform that enable Gusto to safely leverage agentic AI to interact with tax concepts in a way that ensures compliance, accuracy, stability, and reliability.

• Engage in a highly supportive environment working with others to drive productivity and innovation

• Own and drive the technical strategy and roadmap for your team’s domain area in alignment with team and group-level OKRs

• Identify and prioritize long-term investments to improve foundational systems and architecture

• Lead improvements to incident response processes, tooling, and culture to enhance system reliability and team effectiveness

• Mentor and develop engineers on your team working to create holistic and scalable solutions. Track record of elevating team capabilities through pairing, code review, and knowledge sharing.

Here’s what we're looking for:

• Successful applicants have at least 10+ years of experience

• Experience in designing and developing robust, distributed systems using multiple general-purpose programming languages

• Experience influencing and guiding the work of multiple teams on scaling, refactoring, and optimizing legacy products

• Experience architecting, building, and testing large-scale production level code

• An aptitude and interest in bringing clarity and simplicity to complex and ambiguous problems

• Ability to communicate technical complexity and help facilitate informed tradeoffs

• Enthusiasm for a highly collaborative, test-driven environment

• Able to build maintainable, structured, well-documented code

• Experience building fault-tolerant, mission-critical software

• Experience building products in highly regulated and high risk domains

• Experience in one of these domains is preferred: Payroll, Taxes, or Compliance

• Familiar with current AI tools (LLMs, Agents) and their shortcomings / benefits

• Embeds AI in daily development workflow (scaffolding tests, summarizing docs) to measurably reduce cycle time.

• Mentors engineers on effective AI usage and helps develop an AI strategy for other engineers

• Bonus: Experience with Ruby on Rails, Typescript, and React

Our cash compensation for this role is targeted at $189,000–$236,000 per year in Denver and most remote locations, and $223,000–$278,000 per year in San Francisco and New York. Stock equity is offered in addition. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the ranges listed above.
At Gusto, we don't use titles the traditional way, as a signal of rank or hierarchy. Instead, our titles describe two things at once — your craft (what you do, e.g. Engineering, Design) and your scope of ownership (what you're accountable for) — which is why you'll see something like "Head of X" instead of a rank word like "Director" that tells you neither. Because of this, the title on this posting may look different from what you'd expect based on the scope and seniority of the role, and from how similar roles are typically titled elsewhere. If you have questions about how this role compares to your current title or level, your recruiter can help translate.
Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale.
Note: The San Francisco office expectations encompass both the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas.
When approved to work from a location other than a Gusto office, a secure, reliable, and consistent internet connection is required. This includes non-office days for hybrid employees.
Reliable, consistent presence: We expect regular and predictable attendance, whether you're working in-office, hybrid, or fully remote, so that you stay closely connected to your team, customers, and stakeholders in real time and ensure colleagues and customers receive the timely support and responsiveness they deserve.
Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Gusto.
Gusto is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Gusto considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Gusto is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. We want to see our candidates perform to the best of their ability. If you require a medical or religious accommodation at any time throughout your candidate journey, please fill out this form and a member of our team will get in touch with you.
Gusto takes security and protection of your personal information very seriously. Please review our Fraudulent Activity Disclaimer .
Personal information collected and processed as part of your Gusto application will be subject to Gusto's Applicant Privacy Notice .

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/gusto-inc-senior-staff-engineer-tax-platform

job.title: Staff Software Engineer, Safety Platform
job.description:
Headquarters: San Francisco Bay Area or Remote (U.S.)
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Discord is used by over 200 million people every month for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does on our platform: play video games. Over 90% of our users play games, spending a combined 1.5 billion hours playing thousands of unique titles on Discord each month. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to talk and hang out before, during, and after playing games.
The Safety Platform team is at the heart of keeping Discord safe for all users. We provide the infrastructure and services that enable scalable and reliable safety on Discord. We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer who will be a technical leader and force multiplier for the Safety Platform team. You'll autonomously deliver high-impact projects that are often ambiguous and open-ended, while setting the technical direction for safety systems that protect millions of users daily.
As a Staff Engineer on Safety Platform, you'll not only be a top code contributor but also help the entire team level up through technical mentorship, architectural guidance, and fostering a culture of excellence. You'll embrace an "all problems are my problem" mindset, helping teammates overcome obstacles while maintaining Discord's high quality bar.

What You'll Be Doing

• Serve as a technical lead and mentor, guiding ICs through design, experimentation, and implementation while raising the technical bar

• Define and drive Safety Platform’s technical strategy and roadmap

• Set the bar in technical reviews, including code, design, and architecture, ensuring the team builds scalable, robust, and high-quality systems

• Collaborate cross-functionally with product, data science, policy, legal, and engineering partners to align on safety goals and deliver effective solutions

• Tackle the most complex and high-impact challenges in safety, including adversarial abuse, harmful content detection, and evolving threat vectors

• Influence the company’s direction on safety, clearly communicating trade-offs and technical constraints to senior leadership and stakeholders

What you should have

• 8+ years of professional experience in an infrastructure focused software development role

• Strong programming skills in languages like Python, Rust, Typescript

• Experience designing and deploying scalable services using components such as PubSub, GCP/AWS, and Kubernetes

• Experience with large-scale distributed systems serving millions of users, including deployment tools and infrastructure automations like Terraform

• Experience leading projects on cross-team and company-wide scale

• Experience scaling and migrating systems with little to no downtime

• Experience mentoring engineers at various stages in their careers

• Experience driving a culture of operational excellence, with a deep understanding of metrics, alerts, and dashboards

Bonus Points

• A strong passion for Discord and gaming

• Experience tackling safety problems in collaboration with ML teams at large-scale social platforms

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance; a 401(k) plan; life and disability insurance; paid time off; and paid parental leave. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits. Applications for this role are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Base Salary
$279,000 — $341,000 USD

Why Discord?

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!

job.title: Staff Software Engineer, Enterprise Platform
job.description:
Headquarters: San Francisco Bay Area or Remote (West Coast)
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Discord's Enterprise Technology org is building a software engineering discipline from the ground up, and this is the founding engineering hire. There is no Enterprise Platform team yet. You will not be maintaining a status quo or joining an existing backlog: you will define the discipline, set the technical foundation, and build the platform that lets the internal systems enabling Discordians scale with the company.
Discord's mission is to cultivate belonging, and doing that at scale requires internal systems that move as fast as the product itself. The mission of this role is to turn our enterprise infrastructure into self-service software. Your job is to replace manual consoles and tickets with a platform of reusable primitives, building blocks like "provision a device" or "push an IAM policy or app integration through code," exposed through clean APIs and self-service portals. As a code-forward Staff engineer, you will design abstractions that hide the messy reality of Okta, Jamf, and Terraform (our identity, device management, and infrastructure-as-code tools) behind interfaces people actually want to use, operating with a platform-as-a-product mindset.
What You'll Do

• Manage the device fleet as code: Move device configuration off consoles and into versioned, API-driven infrastructure for endpoint management and hardware provisioning.

• Automate the identity layer: Manage identity systems and their connections to downstream apps as code, from SSO and SCIM integrations to account workflows, so changes ship through version control and CI/CD instead of an admin console.

• Own app delivery and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC): Build deployment pipelines and provisioning patterns that let internal systems be built and changed safely, establishing CI/CD standards.

• Build the self-service layer: Design and ship the APIs, CLIs, and portals that compose primitives into paved paths, like a new hire's first day, where software access and group memberships land in one automated, auditable flow.

• Set the foundation: Define the technical direction and architecture for the discipline, writing the RFCs and documentation that future hires will build on.

What You Should Have

• 6+ years building and operating production software and systems at a technology company, with a track record of owning ambiguous projects end to end.

• Strong software engineering fundamentals. You write production code (we lean on Python, TypeScript and Rust), and design, test, and ship it. This is not a systems admin role.

• Deep, hands-on IAM experience (SSO, SCIM, OAuth/OIDC, RBAC) and fluency with infrastructure as code (Terraform) and CI/CD.

• Experience treating endpoint and fleet management as an API-driven engineering surface at scale.

• A platform-as-a-product mindset. You have built self-service tooling that people chose to adopt.

• Comfort with ambiguity and a founder's temperament; energized by building from scratch.

Bonus Points

• Hands-on experience with Okta, Jamf, or Intune.

• Experience with identity and access governance for non-human, workload, or AI-agent principals.

• Background at a high-growth consumer tech company with a highly technical employee base.

The base salary range for this full-time position is listed below. This position will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance; a 401(k) plan; life and disability insurance; paid time off; and paid parental leave. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits. Applications for this role are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Base Salary
$248,000 — $310,000 USD

Why Discord?

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!

job.title: Senior Product Manager, Field Systems (Salesforce)
job.description:
Headquarters: -REMOTE, USA-
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

Smartsheet is looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the Field Systems team, the group responsible for designing, evolving, and scaling the commercial go-to market tools including CRM, e-signature, opportunity management, sales engagement, marketing automation, and forecasting platforms. You will own the product roadmap and serve as the connective tissue between business stakeholders and an agile delivery team to ensure the right work gets prioritized, scoped, and shipped at the right time.
This is a high-impact role at the intersection of enterprise systems, business strategy, and Scaled agile execution. You'll thrive here if you love translating complex business needs into clear, actionable requirements, leveraging modern AI tools to work smarter and faster, and partnering closely with sales, marketing, finance, and customer success to drive measurable outcomes.
You will report to our Director, Field Systems. This is a remote eligible position and you may work remotely from anywhere in the US where Smartsheet is registered.
You Will:

• Partner with the Director of Field Systems to define, maintain, and communicate a prioritized product roadmap aligned to company go-to-market objectives

• Continuously assess the value, urgency, and feasibility of roadmap initiatives to ensure the team is always working on the highest-impact problems

• Translate strategic priorities into quarterly PI (Program Increment) objectives within the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe)

• Engage directly with internal stakeholders including Sales, Sales Operations, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success and Technical Support to deeply understand pain points, workflows, and business goals

• Define clear epics, features, and user stories with well-articulated acceptance criteria.

• Lead discovery activities including stakeholder interviews, process walkthroughs, and data analysis to inform solution design

• Leverage AI tools such as Claude and Gemini to accelerate requirements documentation, synthesize stakeholder feedback, draft communications, and surface insights from data bringing a modern, AI-augmented approach to everyday PM work

• Serve as the Product Owner for the agile team, owning and grooming the team backlog to ensure a healthy queue of well-refined work

• Actively participate in SAFe ceremonies including PI Planning, Refinement, Sprint Planning, Sprint Retrospectives, and System Demos

• Make real-time prioritization and trade-off decisions to keep the team moving and unblocked

• Maintain transparent, proactive communication with stakeholders on roadmap status, delivery timelines, and change impacts

• Build trust with business partners by consistently delivering on commitments and surfacing risks early

• Collaborate with change management and enablement teams to ensure successful adoption of new capabilities

• Define success metrics for features and initiatives; track outcomes post-deployment and use data to inform future prioritization

• Drive retrospective insights from delivery into roadmap refinement and team process improvements

You Have:

• 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years focused on go-to market tools and platform products in an enterprise environment

• Demonstrated experience working within SAFe or agile framework, including PI Planning and cross-team coordination

• Strong product sense with experience balancing user needs, business value, and technical feasibility

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present confidently to senior leaders and technical teams alike

• Experience writing detailed epics and features, lean business cases, and user stories with strong assumptions and acceptance criteria

• Comfort with data including the ability to query data, interpret metrics, and build business cases

• Salesforce Administrator or Business Analyst certification

• Experience supporting sales operations, revenue operations, or marketing operations functions

• Familiarity with CPQ, Sales Cloud, or Service Cloud implementations

• Hands-on experience with AI productivity tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT) applied to PM workflows such as documentation, research, or analysis.

• SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager certification

• Legally eligible to work in the U.S. on an ongoing basis

Current US Perks & Benefits:

• Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees

• 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)

• Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity

• Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off

• US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans

• US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year

• Up to 24 weeks of Parental Leave

• Personal paid Volunteer Day to support our community

• Opportunities for professional growth and development including access to Udemy online courses

• Company Funded Perks, including a counseling membership, local retail discounts, and your own personal Smartsheet account

• Teleworking options from any registered location in the U.S. (role specific)

Smartsheet provides a competitive base salary range for roles that may be hired in different geographic areas we are licensed to operate our business from. Actual compensation is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, level of professional, educational experience, skills, and specific candidate location. In addition, this role will be eligible for a market competitive incentive opportunity.

US Base Salary Pay Range
$135,000 — $176,250 USD

Get to Know Us:
At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.
Equal Opportunity Employer:
Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information.
If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.
