job.title: Engagement Manager
job.description:
Headquarters: -REMOTE, USA-
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

Smartsheet is a tech company with a human story to tell. We’re here to empower teams to manage projects, automate workflows, and rapidly build new secure solutions, using simple no-code tools. We’re revolutionaries – so for us changing the way the world works is all in a day’s work.
As an Engagement Manager within Customer Excellence and Professional Services at Smartsheet, you will play a critical role in setting customers up for success by prescriptively crafting and then leading the execution of large and transformative enterprise projects for our most strategic customers. The Engagement Manager serves as a trusted advisor to Smartsheet customers, provides mentorship to Sales & Professional Services teams, drives alignment across each customer’s projects, and ensures the highest customer satisfaction levels.
Partnered with the Account Team, Services Sales, and Service Delivery, the Engagement Manager contributes to pre-sales scoping and discovery activities, acting as a conduit across the organization to develop and articulate comprehensive implementation proposals. The Engagement Manager will then maintain the executive relationships and act as a critical issue point within these implementations in a billable capacity, ensuring tight customer alignment and offering proactive and prescriptive advice resulting in outstanding Customer Success.
As the Engagement Manager, you will manage several projects/programs concurrently spanning 1 or more Large Enterprise customers. Engagement managers will have a targeted utilization rate, be responsible for the development of best practices, and will manage business processes.
You will report to the Manager of Engagement Delivery, this is a remote eligible position and you may work remotely from anywhere in the US where Smartsheet is registered
You Will:

• Support the account team with pre-sales scoping and discovery activities through Discovery Workshops and pre-engagement planning sessions with the customer

• Actively enroll the required staff resources at the right time to maximize impact, utilization and customer outcomes.

• Manage and drive competing requests across simultaneous strategic client engagements.

• Identify, pull together, and drive project activities of teams from cross-functional and partner sources

• Provide insight into Engagement and Client level revenue forecasting for Monthly and Quarterly targets

• Manage project to time, budget, and contracted deliverables (including planning, scheduling, milestone reviews, etc.)

• Manage project P&L to targeted margin results

• Drive project reviews for management and customers. As requested, support the account team with preparing and leading customer Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) during and after project execution

• Operate as additional eyes and ears within current accounts to identify and unlock follow-on opportunities.

• Create momentum to accelerate delivery and shorten time to value with our customers

• Ensure that engagements conclude with delighted clients that are willing to be referenced for new potential clients

• Proactively mitigate and handle critical customer concerns and at-risk accounts; communicate optimally and appropriately with internal and external leaders and executives.

• Own the escalation response using a consistent, documented escalation process and coordination for active projects and provide mentorship on escalation management to other Professional Services team members

• Ensure quality and time management processes are followed by the team e.g., change controls, time card submissions, status reporting, risk and issue logging)

• Contribute to the development and ownership of the Smartsheet Delivery Methodology and Professional Services PMO function

• Contribute to engagement delivery standard operating procedures (SOPs)

• Function as a frontline resource for “best practice” and informal customer questions

• Liaison with necessary teams within Smartsheet to achieve the above items

• Other duties as assigned

You Have:

• 4+ years of experience in customer-facing positions in a professional capacity ideally at Software or SaaS Provider

• At least 2 years of Project and Program Management experience at the enterprise level

• 2+ years of experience, leading customer-facing engagements in the enterprise space

• Management of large billable projects for external customers

• Experience using generative AI tools (e.g., Claude) to accelerate drafting, analysis, and process design, with sound judgment on accuracy, confidentiality, and customer data handling.

• Experience with modern services deployment methodologies, with emphasis on software design and development

• Use of formal project management tools

• Expert-Level Scope control for fixed-fee engagements.

• Passion for working with leading-edge, web-based technologies and a desire to understand Smartsheet’s benefits, values, use cases, and business and technical elements

• Desire to work in a collaborative environment to promote and improve team performance

• Strong analytical skills regarding client and project management issues

• Strong organizational skills with an ability to manage competing client demands

• Ability to interact and communicate with CxO-level personnel with confidence and clarity

• Excellent communications and interpersonal skills

• One or more Industry Recognized Certifications Including;

• Project Management Professional Certification (PMP)

• Certified Scrum Master (CSM)

• Lean or Six Sigma certification

• Smartsheet Core and/or Project Management Certification

• Advanced degree (Masters Level) preferred or equivalent combination of relevant work experience and education

• Willing to travel periodically (up to 20-30%) based on customer and business needs

• Authorization to work in the U.S. for any employer on an ongoing basis

• Has Smartsheet Certified Professional credential or has the ability to become certified within 3 months

• Experience with process improvement and the development of tools & processes that enable team member success

Current US Perks & Benefits:

• Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees

• 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)

• Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity

• Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off

• US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans

• US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year

• Up to 24 weeks of Parental Leave

• Personal paid Volunteer Day to support our community

• Opportunities for professional growth and development including access to Udemy online courses

• Company Funded Perks, including a counseling membership, local retail discounts, and your own personal Smartsheet account

• Teleworking options from any registered location in the U.S. (role specific)

Smartsheet provides a competitive base salary range for roles that may be hired in different geographic areas we are licensed to operate our business from. Actual compensation is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, level of professional, educational experience, skills, and specific candidate location. In addition, this role will be eligible for a market competitive incentive opportunity.

US Base Salary Pay Range
$92,500 — $126,250 USD

Get to Know Us:
At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.
Equal Opportunity Employer:
Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information.
If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.

job.title: Founding Tech Lead (GrowthBricks)
job.description:
Headquarters: Amsterdam, Netherlands; Belgrade, Serbia; Berlin, Germany; Paphos, Cyprus; Remote, Germany; Warsaw, Poland

Founding Tech Lead (GrowthBricks)
Are you a hands-on engineer who loves zero-to-one challenges? Do you want to build systems with real context and memory that do more than reason, use tools, and drive actual business outcomes?

About JetBrains
We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.
GrowthBricks is a new project at JetMinds, backed by JetBrains, designed to give GTM teams and AI agents a shared business brain. Business context usually gets fragmented across CRMs, documents, dashboards, and people's heads. GrowthBricks brings that context together so agents and people can make decisions and execute effectively across the sales, marketing, and product stack.

About GrowthBricks
GrowthBricks is a shared business brain for GTM teams and AI agents.
It brings together the context that usually lives across CRM, docs, dashboards, tools, and people’s heads: who we sell to, why customers buy, what matters now, what we tried, and what worked. Agents and people use that context to decide what to do next and execute across the GTM stack.
GrowthBricks is a new project at JetMinds, backed by JetBrains.

About the role
We’re looking for a hands-on Founding Tech Lead to build GrowthBricks from zero.
You’ll work directly with the product founder and own the technical side of the product: architecture, core systems, integrations, and the agent layer.
The core challenge is turning fragmented, changing business context into reliable memory and agent actions across tools and measuring whether those actions actually drive business outcomes.
You’ll write a lot of the early code yourself, make the key technical decisions, and shape the product as we learn what works.

What you’ll work on

• Design the core architecture: business context, agents, tools, integrations, and feedback loops.

• Build agentic workflows that can reason over company context and act across CRM, sales, marketing, and product systems.

• Build context extractors from GTM team artifacts like sales calls, emails, internal documents, CRM state, marketing campaigns, etc.

• Work on prompting, context management, memory, tool use, and orchestration.

• Connect GrowthBricks to the existing GTM stack rather than rebuilding everything around it.

• Decide where to use MCP, APIs, frameworks, or third-party tools and where a custom solution is worth it.

• Prototype fast, discard weak ideas, and turn the useful ones into product primitives.

We expect that you

• Are a strong hands-on engineer who enjoys zero-to-one work.

• Have built with LLMs, agents, or agentic workflows used by real people, and improved them based on failures, evaluations, and user feedback.

• Understand how context, prompting, tools, and agent behavior fit together.

• Can design backend systems, APIs, data models, and integrations.

• Are comfortable making decisions before all the answers are known.

• Prefer simple, pragmatic solutions over unnecessary complexity.

We’re especially interested if you

• Have worked in solution engineering, sales engineering, pre-sales, or built software for GTM teams.

• Understand the modern GTM stack: CRM, enrichment, outbound, automation, and product signals.

• Have automated sales or marketing workflows, ideally with agents or LLMs.

• Have owned a technical product from a blank repo to something people actually used.

GTM experience is not mandatory, but if you already understand how sales and marketing teams work, that is a strong advantage.

What we offer

• A competitive salary and strong benefits package.

• The runway and resources of an established company, with startup-level autonomy.

• A founding role with direct influence over both product and architecture.

• Real users and real workflows from day one.

• Freedom to choose the stack, tools, and technical approach.

• A chance to help define what an agent-native GTM product should look like.

job.title: Entrepreneur in Residence/Product Lead
job.description:
Headquarters: Amsterdam, Netherlands; Belgrade, Serbia; Berlin, Germany; Limassol, Cyprus; London, United Kingdom; Madrid, Spain; Munich, Germany; Paphos, Cyprus; Prague, Czech Republic; Remote, Germany; Warsaw, Poland; Yerevan, Armenia
Are you a builder who thrives in ambiguity, gets energy from talking to real users, and wants to turn emerging agentic AI capabilities into a product people actually rely on?

About JetBrains
We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do
NoPressure is an early-stage startup within JetBrains' Innovation Hub. We started by using AI-powered simulations to help people practice high-stakes workplace conversations. Now, we're exploring how agentic AI and real-world context can provide personalized, moment-of-need practice and support at work.
We’re looking for an Entrepreneur in Residence / Product Lead to partner with our technical founder. This is a 0→1 role where you’ll define our vision and venture strategy. You’ll figure out who our ideal customer is, identify high-value use cases, and validate key hypotheses through rapid experimentation. Working alongside a small, fast-moving engineering team, you will shape both the product and how it gets to market, turning early signals into something organizations want to adopt.
Day to day, you will:

• Define the product and venture strategy, identifying key uncertainties and deciding what to test and build first.

• Conduct continuous customer discovery to understand real workplace workflows, pain points, and behaviors.

• Pinpoint the most compelling ideal customer profile (ICP) and initial use cases for growth.

• Design and run lightweight experiments, prototypes, and agentic experiences to test hypotheses before committing full engineering resources.

• Establish clear metrics and evaluate commercial and behavioral evidence to decide whether to iterate, double down, or pivot.

• Shape positioning, messaging, and early acquisition or sales motions to bring the product to initial customers.

• Monitor market shifts, emerging agent architectures, and competitor developments to uncover new opportunities.

• Collaborate closely with the technical founder and engineering team to move quickly from ideas to shipped prototypes.

What you’ll bring

• A builder mindset that favors quick prototypes and direct learning over waiting for perfect requirements.

• Deep curiosity about how people build new skills and navigate challenging interactions at work.

• Comfort operating with high autonomy, speed, and decision-making under uncertainty.

• Strong discovery skills that separate genuine demand and observed behavior from polite validation.

• Clear, direct communication skills for pitching to and working with senior decision-makers.

• Strong collaboration habits when partnering closely with engineering teams on AI-native products.

What you’ll need

• A Track record of taking products or ventures from initial ambiguity to launch and early market adoption.

• Hands-on experience building, launching, or experimenting with AI/agentic products or emerging technologies.

• Demonstrated experience in early customer acquisition, founder-led sales, positioning, or commercialization.

• Experience in L&D, coaching, sales enablement, HR tech, or behavior-change products.

• The technical fluency required to evaluate agentic workflows and work directly alongside software engineers.

• End-to-end ownership experience across strategy, discovery, product development, and go-to-market strategy.

What success looks like
In this role, success means rapidly turning market ambiguity into actionable direction. You will establish a validated ideal customer profile and high-value use cases through real user evidence rather than assumptions. You’ll build an experimental cadence that uncovers genuine demand early, helping the team ship an agentic AI experience that users regularly rely on and organizations actively invest in.

Why join JetBrains?

• Strong base salary – We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.

• Flexible work schedule – Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.

• Extra time off – More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.

• Learning and development opportunities – Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.

• Relocation support – Assistance to help make your move as smooth and stress-free as possible.

• Free meals and snacks – Lunch and refreshments provided to keep you fueled.

• Health and wellness – On-site gyms or sports club stipends.

• Internal events – Company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.

job.title: Relationship Manager- Mandarin Speaking
job.description:
The world of payment processing is rapidly evolving, and businesses are looking for loyal and strategic partners, to help them grow.
Meet Nuvei , Nuvei is the global fintech building the infrastructure for every payment, everywhere. Its modular, flexible, and scalable technology enables leading companies to accept next-generation payments, offer all payout options, and benefit from card issuing, banking, risk, and fraud management services. Connecting businesses to their customers in more than 200 markets, with local acquiring in 52 markets, 150 currencies, and over 720 alternative payment methods, Nuvei provides the technology and insights for customers and partners to succeed locally and globally through one integration.
At Nuvei , we live our core values, and we thrive on solving complex problems. We’re dedicated to continually improving our product and providing relentless customer service. We are always looking for exceptional talent to join us on the journey!
We’re looking for an experienced and proactive Account Manager to help reach our APAC ambitions. You will be managing key account relationships across multiple industries and channels for our cross-border merchants. The ideal candidate is a born networker who thrives in a fast-paced, diverse, and entrepreneurial environment.

Responsibilities

• Fully responsible for the success and satisfaction of your merchants in your portfolio.

• Build strong relationships with key contacts across multi continents and time zones.

• Build and sustain relationships with key merchant stakeholders, and leverage those relationships to drive the best possible merchant experience

• Ensure a positive and consistent relationship for one or more assigned clients

• Serve as primary point of contact to support problem resolution and ensure client retention

• Work and collaborate with colleagues in the Global Nuvei Team

Requirements

• At least 3-5 years of experience managing enterprise-level clients in a fast-paced & dynamic environment

• Knowledge of payments and acquiring is a must

• You're a high-energy, dynamic, hands-on self-starter with a proven commercial edge and entrepreneurial drive

• You enjoy working in uncertain situations, and you can deal with ambiguity

• You're an excellent communicator who can build relations at all levels

• You are a very detailed person

• You can work seamlessly with a global, multicultural team

• You are well organized with good time management skills

• You have strong aptitude to analyze and solve problems

• Willingness to work across different time zones

• Fluent in Mandarin and proficient in English

• Travel required (~5%)

Benefits

• Competitive holiday allowance

• 401K Matching program

• Group Insurance Benefits

• Flexible working model

• Employee Assistance Program

Nuvei is an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates collaboration and innovation and is committed to developing a diverse and inclusive workplace. The team at Nuvei is comprised of a wealth of talent, skill, and ambition. We believe that employees are happiest when they’re empowered to be their true, authentic selves. So, please come as you are. We can’t wait to meet you.
Working Language
English (written and spoken) is the language used most of the time, as work colleagues, clients, and strategic suppliers are geographically dispersed.
Our recruitment process may use automated tools, including AI, to support application management and candidate shortlisting.

job.title: Full Stack AI Lead Developer
job.description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.
Job Responsibilities

• End-to-End AI Application Development: Design, build, and deploy full-stack artificial intelligence applications from the ground up, seamlessly connecting robust backend AI services with responsive, user-friendly frontends.

• AI Model Integration & Orchestration: Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs), local model pipelines, vector databases, and multi-agent orchestration frameworks (such as RAG architectures) into production-ready software systems.

• Database Architecture & Performance Optimization: Architect, query, and optimize complex relational databases ( PostgreSQL preferred ), writing advanced SQL queries, multi-table joins, cursors, and stored procedures to guarantee high-performance data retrieval and storage.

• Backend Engineering & APIs: Develop high-performance, asynchronous backend services, RESTful APIs, and data ingestion pipelines primarily using Python to handle real-time data streaming and complex business logic.

• UI/UX & Dashboard Development: Build intuitive, responsive user interfaces and real-time operational dashboards using modern web frameworks to enable seamless human-AI interaction and telemetry visualization.

• Containerization & DevOps: Package applications using Docker and manage deployment, scaling, and cluster coordination using Kubernetes to ensure enterprise-grade reliability and fault tolerance.

• Cloud & Infrastructure Management: Provision, configure, and optimize cloud resources (primarily AWS ) and high-performance computing environments (including GPU clusters) to support heavy AI workloads.

• Linux System Operations: Operate effectively within Linux environments, utilizing advanced shell utilities, system monitoring, and performance tuning for backend stability.

• Team Mentorship & Onboarding: Actively mentor, train, and guide junior developers and team members under your purview, rapidly bringing them up to speed on technical frameworks, coding standards, and best practices.

• Stakeholder Communication & Live Demos: Communicate effectively with diverse internal and external stakeholders, translating complex technical concepts into clear business value, and confidently conduct live, end-to-end software and AI application demonstrations.

• Quality & Continuous Improvement: Apply a quality-first mindset (incorporating principles like Lean Six Sigma where applicable) to debug issues, optimize system latency, automate testing, and ensure high reliability.

• Technology Exploration & Innovation: Stay on the cutting edge of AI advancements, rapidly evaluating, prototyping, and integrating emerging open-source tools, frameworks, and model updates into the enterprise stack.

Desired Criteria :
We are looking for a candidate who combines deep technical expertise with a strong quality-first mindset. Specifically, the ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with:

• Core Technical Stack: Advanced Python development, AWS cloud infrastructure, and enterprise Linux administration.

• DevOps & Deployment: Expertise in containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes) for large-scale enterprise deployments.

• AI & Innovation: Proven ability to build and deploy modern AI solutions (Multi-agent systems, RAG) and a passion for quickly adopting emerging technologies.

• Quality & Process: A background in Lean Six Sigma and other quality tools to ensure operational excellence and high-reliability software.

BE AWARE OF FRAUD: When applying for a job at Jabil you will be contacted via correspondence through our official job portal with a jabil.com e-mail address; direct phone call from a member of the Jabil team; or direct e-mail with a jabil.com e-mail address. Jabil does not request payments for interviews or at any other point during the hiring process. Jabil will not ask for your personal identifying information such as a social security number, birth certificate, financial institution, driver’s license number or passport information over the phone or via e-mail. If you believe you are a victim of identity theft, contact your local police department. Any scam job listings should be reported to whatever website it was posted in. Jabil , including its subsidiaries, is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Accessibility Accommodation
If you are a qualified individual with a disability, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access Jabil .com/Careers site as a result of your disability. You can request a reasonable accommodation by sending an e-mail to with the nature of your request and contact information. Please do not direct any other general employment related questions to this e-mail. Please note that only those inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to.#whereyoubelong Originally posted on Himalayas

job.title: Senior Project Manager - Data Center
job.description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
At AHEAD , we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD .
We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.
We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD .
The Senior Project Manager is responsible for the management of assigned technical projects. The duties include facilitating coaching and mentoring the junior project management staff. The Project Manager executes day-to-day management of assigned project segments. In addition, the Project Manager manages the group of projects as a whole, providing a single point of knowledge and control for the aggregate effort.

Key Responsibilities

• Plan and coordinate all aspects of technical projects from initiation through delivery.

• Ensure service delivery success and customer satisfaction through effective project management.

• Manage project initiation activities, which include the identification of contractual obligations, client needs and goals, existing situations, and necessary contacts. Gain access to existing information as needed.

• Develop, define, and execute project plans, project scope, activities, schedules, budgets, and deliverables.

• Identify needed resources for projects while defining and assigning major project roles.

• Coordinate activities and tasks among project team members, other internal departments, and client or vendor/subcontractor organizations as needed to meet project goals, and ensure project completion is on schedule, within budget constraints, and of the appropriate quality standards for the project scope.

• Assign and monitor the work of the project team, providing technical and analytical support and direction.

• Interface with clients on technical matters as needed.

• Manage project risks, issues/problems, and activity progress to ensure project goals (e.g., deadline, scope, and quality) are achieved.

• Assist with problem resolution or risk mitigation as needed.

• Manage the integration of vendor/subcontractor tasks as well as track and review vendor/subcontractor deliverables, if appropriate for the project.

• Serve as liaison between technical and non-technical teams and vendor/subcontractor organizations to ensure all project targets and requirements are met.

• Conduct project closure activities to formalize and communicate the project acceptance, handover documentation, and ongoing activities. This includes completing a post-implementation review to identify areas of improvement.

• Directly oversee employees assigned to the project. Selects, develops, and evaluates personnel to ensure the efficient operation of the function.

• Identify project management coordination process gaps or areas for improvement. Recommends and implements solutions.

• Utilize Ahead systems (PSA, etc.) to maintain updated project information.

• Assist in presales efforts including OA, SOWs, and customer presentations.

• Develop customer relationships and aid in identifying additional sales opportunities.

Skills Required

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent would be required

• Minimum of 12 years of experience in project management, with a focus on leading and delivering complex projects or programs.

• Professional certifications like PMP (Project Management Professional) or PgMP (Program Management Professional) preferred.

• Must have experience with data center/workload migrations, data center consolidation, and/or data center build outs.

• Strong technical knowledge in Dell, VMware, Rubrik, NetApp, etc.

• Strong ability to independently manage medium to high risk, high complexity, and high client visibility projects.

• Must have a strategic mindset and be able to align projects or programs with organizational goals.

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, team, conflict management, and time management skills.

• Strong communication & leadership skills.

• Possess advanced skills in the use of project management software.

• Demonstrate ability to manage project budgets and timelines.

• Must be adept with the use of negotiation techniques to reach an agreement when there are widely differing viewpoints.

• Effectively facilitate interaction with executive-level clients.

• Should be able to identify, assess, and mitigate risks effectively.

Why AHEAD :
Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD , we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between.
We fuel growth by stacking our office with top-notch technologies in a multi-million-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning.

India Employment Benefits include:
Comprehensive health insurance coverage for employees, with options to extend coverage to dependents
Paid time off and company holidays , along with additional leave benefits as per policy
Flexible work arrangements , supporting work-life balance
Learning and development opportunities to support continuous growth and upskilling
Employee wellness initiatives and programs focused on physical and mental well-being
Retirement and statutory benefits in line with India regulations
Inclusive and people-first culture , with a strong focus on collaboration and ownership

job.title: Product User Research, Intern
job.description:
ABOUT SARVAM AI

Sarvam AI is building India's sovereign AI stack, spanning foundational models, infrastructure and applications. Our mission is to make powerful AI accessible and useful for India, building technology that works across languages, industries and real-world use cases.

As we continue to build and scale our products, understanding how people interact with them becomes increasingly important. We're looking for a curious and research-oriented intern to help us understand our users better and shape the experiences we build.



THE ROLE

As a Product User Research Intern, you'll work closely with our product, design and engineering teams to understand user behaviour, identify friction points and uncover opportunities to improve our products.

You'll interact directly with developers, product managers and founders, study how they use Sarvam's products, and translate your findings into actionable insights that influence product and design decisions.

This is an opportunity to work on a new user research function at Sarvam, helping establish research practices and processes from the ground up. You'll also get ownership of a primary product area and the opportunity to see your research translate into real product improvements.



WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

 - Understand our users: Conduct user interviews, surveys and usability studies with developers, PMs and founders to understand their needs, behaviours and challenges.

 - Improve product experiences: Research user journeys across Sarvam's developer console, playground, API documentation and applications. Identify friction points across onboarding, API key creation, first API calls, billing and other key workflows.

 - Study developer journeys: Analyse the developer funnel, from sign-up to making the first API call and eventually becoming a paying user. Understand where users drop off and, more importantly, why.

 - Test and evaluate designs: Conduct usability testing on existing interfaces and new prototypes, run preference and A/B tests, and benchmark experiences against other developer products.

 - Turn research into insights: Analyse qualitative and quantitative data, identify patterns and present clear recommendations to product, design, growth and support teams.

 - Build the research practice: Help establish research playbooks, interview templates, participant recruitment processes and a research repository that can scale with the team.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong curiosity about user behaviour and a genuine interest in understanding why people use products the way they do.

 - Comfortable speaking with users, conducting interviews and asking thoughtful, unbiased questions.

 - Technical fluency — you should be comfortable reading API documentation, making basic API calls using tools like Postman, curl or Python, and understanding what might have gone wrong when an API fails.

 - Comfortable working with data, analysing spreadsheets and interpreting product funnels or dashboards.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate research findings into clear insights and recommendations.

job.description:
Headquarters: California; New York; Remote - Colorado; Remote - Georgia; Remote - Ohio; Remote - Oregon; Remote - Pennsylvania; Remote - Texas; Remote - Washington; Remote - Washington D.C.
GAQ327R240
While candidates in the listed location(s) are encouraged for this role, candidates in other locations will be considered.
We're building a finance function that stays ahead of the curve — maximizing self-serve AI capabilities while driving an AI-first automation roadmap to operate at the pace Databricks demands. The Accounting Manager, Accounts Receivable, will serve as a senior individual contributor owning end-to-end technical AR accounting across global AR balances and multiple legal entities, leading multi-entity subledger consolidations as our global footprint expands. Working within a structured preparer/reviewer framework in close partnership with the broader Order-to-Cash (OTC), Revenue, and Finance Transformation teams, this high-ownership role bridges technical accounting rigor with cross-functional operational scale.
Close quality, accurate management reporting, and subledger integrity are non-negotiable. Success in this role requires both strong operational execution and sound technical accounting judgment - applying U.S. GAAP to complex global receivables matters, bad debt modeling, and close accruals to ensure an audit-ready subledger. You will own a high-quality close today while directly shaping how our global receivables accounting operates tomorrow, using an AI-first automation mindset to scale our processes alongside rapid company growth.
The impact you will have:

• Own the Global AR Month-End Close: Autonomously lead the monthly close cycle for Global AR balances, preparing end-to-end subledger-to-GL reconciliations, roll-forward schedules, unbilled revenue, deferred revenue adjustments, contra-AR, complex close accruals, and AR management reporting with clear analysis of material movements and key drivers.

• Technical Accounting & AFDA Modeling: Own the Allowance for Doubtful Accounts (AFDA) and Current Expected Credit Loss (CECL) accounting models; assess underlying assumptions and portfolio trends, prepare monthly provision recommendations, process approved write-offs with full audit trails, and ensure technical U.S. GAAP compliance

• Lead AI & Automation Adoption: Lead the identification, design, and adoption of AI and automation opportunities across AR accounting workflows, leveraging Databricks, LLMs, and advanced analytics to automate manual reconciliations, improve accrual accuracy, strengthen controls, and accelerate period closes.

• Maintain Balance Sheet Integrity: Own AR subledger integrity, flux analyses, variance explanations, and period-over-period movement schedules, providing clear management insights into AR trends, material movements, and key balance sheet drivers for senior Finance leadership.

• Drive Audit Readiness & SOX Controls: Maintain audit-ready workpapers and process documentation; serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external auditors regarding AR schedules, walkthroughs, and audit request responses.

• Cross-Functional Process Alignment: Partner with Billing Operations, Cash Applications, Revenue Assurance, Revenue Accounting, Corporate Accounting, and FP&A teams to validate subledger accuracy, clear unapplied balances, and reconcile AR balances.

• Finance Transformation & SAP Implementation: Partner with our Transformation, Engineering, and IT teams to redesign AR accounting workflows, eliminate manual routines, and drive process standardization, automation, testing, and data readiness for SAP and other systems implementations.

What we look for:

• Experience: 6+ years of progressive AR and GL accounting experience in a mid-to-large organization, with demonstrated ownership of month-end close, AFDA/CECL, subledger-to-GL reconciliations, and AR management reporting.

• Credentials: CPA strongly preferred. Bachelor's Degree in Accounting or Finance.

• Technical Accounting: Strong U.S. GAAP judgment and ability to independently research, document, and defend accounting conclusions relating to receivables, revenue recognition alignment, accrual cut-off, contract assets/liabilities, and expected credit loss methodologies.

• Autonomy & Review Readiness: Proven ability to operate independently with high autonomy, producing clean, reviewer-ready workpapers within a preparer/reviewer/approver framework.

• Systems & ERP: Hands-on ERP experience (SAP, NetSuite, or similar) with the ability to query, reconcile, and validate data across subledger and GL modules.

• M&A & Integration Experience: Prior experience supporting the accounting workstream of an acquisition is a strong plus. Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-moving integration environments with evolving data, processes, and systems is essential.

• The Automation Mindset: Advanced Excel proficiency (Power Query, dynamic arrays) paired with hands-on experience deploying or evaluating AI tools in a finance context; familiarity with data platforms like Databricks is a strong plus.

• Ownership & Mindset: High ownership, detail-oriented, fast-moving, direct communicator, and calm under pressure. Open-minded and change-oriented.

• Scale & Agility: High-growth technology or SaaS industry experience strongly preferred; exposure to recurring or usage-based billing models is an advantage. Public accounting background preferred.

job.title: Technical Account Manager (Mexico)
job.description:
Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:
As a Samsara Technical Account Manager (TAM), you are the cornerstone of technical customer success. In this role, you will act as a trusted technical advisor, moving beyond traditional support to deliver measurable business value and drive the long-term adoption of the Samsara platform. Your mission is to proactively optimize your customers' technical health and mitigate risk, ensuring they achieve their desired outcomes.
This requires a unique blend of deep technical acumen, consultative problem-solving, and the ability to communicate with influence across both technical and executive stakeholders. You will build enduring customer relationships by translating their operational goals into powerful technical solutions. As the primary technical interface for your accounts, you will foster cross-functional collaboration with our Sales, Support, and Product teams to champion your customers' needs. During critical incidents, you will demonstrate ownership by managing customer communications and expectations through to a successful resolution.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in Mexico.

You should apply if:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

• You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.

• You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.

• You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

• Drive Customer Impact & Value Realization: Go beyond technical support to consistently deliver measurable value. You will develop a deep understanding of your customers' business objectives and proactively align Samsara's solutions to help them achieve their goals, tracking and demonstrating technical ROI along the way.

• Use AI to Transform the Customer Experience: Leverage AI-powered tools and insights to anticipate customer needs, personalize engagement, and deliver faster, more proactive, and impactful outcomes.

• Execute Transformational Technical Account Management: Independently manage a portfolio of accounts, developing tailored success plans and identifying and mitigating risks to customer health. You will maintain accurate records of customer interactions and contribute to team-wide objectives.

• Demonstrate Deep Technical Acumen & Samsara Expertise: Be the primary technical point of contact, mastering Samsara's platform, including APIs, hardware, and software. You will advise customers on best practices and troubleshoot complex technical issues with proficiency.

• Provide Consultative Problem Solving & Solutioning: Employ a consultative approach to understand the root cause of customer challenges. You will own the technical ticket lifecycle, including technical escalations from report to resolution, and conduct root cause analysis to prevent recurrence and drive product improvement.

• Communicate with Influence and Clarity: Lead customer meetings, from technical deep dives to quarterly technical account reviews, with confidence. You will adapt your communication style to effectively engage with diverse audiences, from technical staff to non-technical executives.

• Foster Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner effectively with Sales, Support, Product, and Engineering teams to advocate for customer needs and deliver a unified experience.

• Demonstrate Ownership and Act as a Multiplier: Embody a 'get it done' mentality by taking initiative on team projects and process improvements. You will actively contribute to our internal knowledge base and help onboard new team members, sharing best practices to enhance the entire team's capabilities.

• Embody Samsara's Values & Principles: Consistently champion and role model Samsara's core values and operating principles in every interaction, actively seeking feedback for continuous improvement

Minimum requirements for the role:

• Experience: 7+ years experience in a technical, customer-facing role such as technical account management, solutions consulting, or customer success, with a demonstrated track record of success.

• Education: We welcome applications from candidates with a bachelor's degree in a technical field, or those who have gained equivalent expertise through practical experience in areas such as Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields.

• Technical Proficiency: Exceptional technical literacy with the ability to understand and troubleshoot complex hardware, software, and API integrations. A strong passion for technology and a commitment to continuous learning, including an interest in AI and its applications.

• Bilingual: English and Spanish is a must.

• Customer Focus: A data-informed approach to understanding customer needs and a demonstrated ability to build trusted, long-term relationships.

• Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish is required.

• Collaborative Spirit: A team player who thrives in a fast-paced environment and works effectively with internal teams to drive customer success.

An ideal candidate also has:

• Experience supporting global enterprise-level customers in a SaaS, IoT, or PaaS environment.

• Proven experience leveraging AI tools and methodologies in daily workflows to drive efficiency, generate customer insights, and improve overall customer success.

• Prior experience with Samsara, Salesforce, Zendesk, Jira, Gong, Gainsight, and Tableau.

• Basic Python coding skills are an asset for providing enhanced technical solutions

Total Rewards
At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
Flexible Working
At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.
Belonging at Samsara
At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.
Accommodations
Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.
Our Commitment to Authenticity
We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.
Fraudulent Employment Offers
Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here .

About the Role:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced underwriting professional to join our Risk Management team. As an experienced underwriter, you will be responsible for reviewing and assessing the financial risk of new and existing customers, while making decisions based on policy guidelines. You should have experience and subject matter expertise in financial services, end-to-end underwriting lifecycle, portfolio management, bank statement and financial decisioning, and risk assessment.
You’ll evaluate applications, perform analysis that mitigate financial risk, and make timely and accurate decisions on application outcomes. The successful candidate will work as a member of our Risk Organization and collaborate with members from our sales, data science, product management, and other stakeholders to deliver best in class customer experience.

What You'll Do:

• Collect, review and analyze applicants' relevant financial, demographic, and historic information and records. This includes, but is not limited to, analysis of business financial statements such as balance sheets, income statements and cash flow statements, bank statements, and credit reports

• Clearly articulate why and when additional documents are needed in order to determine a client's creditworthiness

• Make determination whether to approve, decline or seek an exception for an application based on policy guidelines

• Make quality decisions in a timely and efficient manner within expected SLA

• Perform portfolio management, evaluating and identifying suspicious or questionable items

• Recommend policy and process improvement to mitigate potential failure points throughout the underwriting journey

• Bank statement analysis, financial spreading and risk ratio analysis culminating with underwriting memo

What We're Looking For:

• 2-3+ years of underwriting experience in financial services, high-growth payments, or fintech company

• Strong critical reasoning, problem solving and analytical skills

• Ability to work independently and thrive in a collaborative team environment

• Excellent oral and written communication skills

• Familiar with fundamentals of financial risk assessment

• Familiar with the U.S. compliance, lending & regulatory environment (KYC, Reg B, Reg Z, UDAAP, FCBA, Truth in Lending Act)

• Strong organization, and time management skills

job.title: Content Management Specialist
job.description:
Who we are:
Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.
Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.
Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

Role overview
The Content Management Specialist owns the operational lifecycle of learning and knowledge content across the learning management system (LMS), knowledgebase, course communications, and New Hire Onboarding (NHO) materials. This role ensures content is accurate, current, easy to find, correctly assigned, and ready for learners and frontline teams.
Working closely with Instructional Designers, program owners, operations partners, and teams responsible for product and process launches, the specialist coordinates complex updates and builds consistent ways to manage content. The role also identifies gaps early and improves workflows to make content operations more reliable and visible.

What you’ll do

• Own content lifecycle workflows: Independently coordinate complex content updates from intake through review, publication, tracking, and retirement. Ensure the correct versions are active and accessible in the LMS and related platforms.

• Coordinate launch-driven updates: Work across stakeholders to identify learning and knowledge content affected by product, process, and operational changes. Clarify owners, dependencies, and timelines, and follow updates through to completion.

• Strengthen content governance: Establish and improve standards for version control, naming, tracking, archiving, and documentation. Maintain a clear view of active, pending, updated, and retired content.

• Manage course and communication assignments: Coordinate learner assignments and reassignments so the appropriate audiences receive the right training at the right time. Track completion and resolve follow-through gaps with relevant partners.

• Lead NHO update tracking: Monitor weekly launches and operational changes, map them to relevant onboarding courses or modules, and coordinate required updates. Keep a reliable record of pending and completed work.

• Protect content quality: Check courses and assessments before or after release. Validate quiz answers, scoring, logic, and completion criteria; flag outdated references, broken content flows, or other learner experience issues.

• Maintain knowledgebase alignment: Coordinate updates to knowledgebase articles using confirmed source material, retire outdated content appropriately, and help keep frontline documentation aligned with current learning materials.

• Improve how work gets done: Proactively identify gaps in content accuracy, coverage, and update readiness. Recommend and implement workflow improvements that reduce manual effort and improve visibility.

• Report status and risks: Keep stakeholders informed about progress, dependencies, upcoming updates, and issues that may affect release timelines or learner readiness.

What you’ll bring

• Experience managing learning content in an LMS or similar content platform.

• Strong attention to detail and a quality-focused approach to published content and assessments.

• Ability to independently organize and manage multiple content workflows, deadlines, and dependencies.

• Strong coordination and communication skills, including the ability to work across teams and follow updates through to completion.

• Experience maintaining trackers or other systems for organizing content, ownership, status, and timelines.

• Familiarity with course assignments, reassignments, learner-facing communications, or training operations.

• Familiarity with knowledgebase maintenance, content versioning, and archival practices.

• Comfort working in a fast-changing environment where priorities and launch timelines can shift.

• A process-improvement mindset and the ability to spot recurring gaps and recommend practical solutions.

How success is measured

• Learning content is reviewed and updated on time, with fewer outdated or duplicate items remaining live.

• Content updates and reassignments are completed accurately and within expected timelines.

• Course assignments reach the correct learner groups, and reassignment requests are tracked through completion.

• Knowledgebase content remains current and outdated articles are retired appropriately.

• NHO updates are completed in step with weekly launches and operational changes.

• Content status, ownership, dependencies, and release timelines are visible and consistently maintained.

job.title: Manager SMB, Spanish Account Management
job.description:
Who we are:
Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.
Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.
Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About the Role
As a Manager, SMB Account Management (Spanish), you will lead the charge in expanding and retaining Motive’s footprint across Spanish-speaking SMB customer accounts, representing a key engine of our global revenue. Our technology solutions create efficiencies and drive revenue growth for businesses across the physical economy trucking, freight & logistics, construction, oil and gas, field services, and local delivery.
We are looking for a bilingual, results oriented sales leader with native or full professional proficiency in Spanish and English. In this role, you will scale and mentor a high velocity team of SMB Account Managers dedicated to Spanish speaking accounts, driving them to exceed monthly and quarterly revenue targets through renewals, upsells, and cross-sells. While this role is primarily remote, you will oversee day-to-day operations and should be open to occasional travel to one of our regional hubs (Islamabad or Lahore).
What You’ll Do

• Drive Revenue & Retention: Lead, mentor, and scale a team of Spanish-speaking SMB Account Managers focused on expanding and retaining existing customer accounts across target Spanish-speaking markets.

• Pipeline & KPI Governance: Establish pipeline targets, outbound touchpoint metrics, and inbound response SLAs, driving strict accountability and operational excellence.

• Culturally Nuanced Execution: Adapt Motive’s global sales playbook to align with regional communication styles, business etiquette, and buyer behavior in Spanish-speaking markets.

• Sales Coaching: Conduct regular call reviews (in Spanish) and coaching sessions to elevate pitch quality, value-based selling, objection handling, and fast closing cycles standard in SMB accounts.

• Forecasting & Visibility: Manage disciplined pipeline hygiene within Salesforce/CRM, providing leadership with reliable, data-backed revenue forecasts, risk analysis, and growth opportunities.

• Portfolio Expansion: Champion Motive’s full suite of products (Vehicle Gateway, AI Dashcams, Motive Card, and emerging software tools) to maximize customer lifetime value (LTV).

• Deal Support: Step into high-stakes negotiations, customer reviews, and product demonstrations in Spanish to help close high-value or complex opportunities.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Sales Operations, Enablement, and Product Marketing to localize training materials, CRM workflows, and campaign collateral.

What We’re Looking For

• Language Fluency: Native or bilingual professional proficiency (C1/C2 level) in both Spanish and English, with exceptional written and verbal negotiation skills in both languages.

• Sales Experience: 4+ years of B2B sales/account management experience, ideally selling into North American (US/Mexico) Hispanic markets, Latin America, or Spain.

• Leadership Track Record: 2+ years of experience leading, coaching, or mentoring sales or account management teams within a fast-paced SaaS, telematics, or tech-enabled environment.

• SMB Velocity: Proven ability to manage high-volume, short-sales-cycle pipelines while maintaining strong renewal and expansion rates.

• Operational Discipline: Deep understanding of CRM workflows (Salesforce preferred), pipeline hygiene, and data-driven sales management.

• Ownership Mindset: Highly autonomous and adaptable, with the ability to build structure and scale regional operations within a rapidly evolving environment.

Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace is one of Motive's core values. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.

job.title: Agile Program Manager
job.description:
We're looking for an experienced Agile Program Manager to lead delivery across multiple cross-functional teams working toward a shared set of business outcomes. You'll sit at the intersection of strategy and execution: translating roadmap priorities into coordinated, predictable delivery, keeping dependencies visible, and making sure the right people are making the right decisions at the right time.
This is a hands-on program role, not a status-reporting one. You'll own the cadence, the plan, and the risks across several Agile teams, and you'll be the person stakeholders trust to tell them where things really stand.

What You'll Do

• Lead end-to-end delivery of a multi-team program, coordinating three or more Agile teams (Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid) toward shared quarterly objectives.

• Run program-level planning, including quarterly/PI planning, roadmap alignment, capacity planning, and release planning.

• Identify, map, and actively manage cross-team dependencies, risks, and blockers, escalating early and with clear options.

• Facilitate program ceremonies such as Scrum of Scrums, program syncs, system demos, and retrospectives, and make sure they produce decisions, not just updates.

• Partner with Product Owners and Product Managers to keep backlogs prioritized, refined, and aligned to business value.

• Build and maintain program-level reporting: delivery health, burn-up/velocity trends, OKR or objective progress, and RAID logs, tailored for both team-level and executive audiences.

• Drive continuous improvement in delivery practices, tooling, and team workflows, coaching teams and leaders on Agile principles where needed.

• Manage stakeholder communication across engineering, product, design, business, and leadership, keeping expectations aligned as scope and priorities shift.

• Track program budget, resourcing, and vendor or third-party deliverables where applicable.

What You Bring

• 8+ years of experience in program or project management, with at least 5 years leading delivery in Agile environments.

• Proven track record managing multi-team programs (not just single-team Scrum) from planning through release.

• Deep, practical knowledge of Scrum and Kanban, plus experience with at least one scaling framework (SAFe, LeSS, Scrum@Scale, or similar).

• Strong command of Agile tooling such as Jira, Jira Align, Azure DevOps, Rally, or equivalent, including building dashboards and program-level reporting.

• Excellent facilitation skills: you can run a 50-person planning event as comfortably as a tense 1:1 escalation.

• Clear, concise written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to tailor the message for engineers and executives alike.

• Experience working with distributed or remote teams across time zones.

• Comfort operating with ambiguity: you can stand up structure where there is none and adapt it as the program evolves.

Nice to Have

• Agile or program management certifications such as SAFe RTE, SAFe SPC, PMI-ACP, PgMP, PMP, CSM/CSP, or ICAgile.

• Experience with Agile transformations or introducing scaled frameworks into an organization.

• Background in software, SaaS, data, or digital product delivery.

• Familiarity with OKRs and value-stream or portfolio management.

• Experience in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, insurance, public sector) where Agile delivery coexists with compliance requirements.

• Budget and vendor management experience on programs with multiple delivery partners.

job.description:
Who we are:
Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.
Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.
Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About the Role:
As a Financial Product Specialist II (Mid-Market), you’ll guide customers through onboarding and early adoption of Motive’s financial products, Motive Card. You’ll own an assigned portfolio, coordinate implementation from post-sales handoff through launch, and help customers activate cards, configure spend controls and build consistent usage.
You’ll partner with customers and internal teams to resolve routine implementation questions, keep adoption milestones moving, and share feedback that can improve our products and processes. This role is suited to an organized, customer-focused, collaborative specialist who communicates clearly and is curious about financial workflows and spend management. You’ll coordinate with the right partners and route high-impact issues to the appropriate escalation owner. As you build product and customer expertise, you can take on more complex implementations and contribute to pilots and process improvements.
What You’ll Do:

• Own assigned Mid-Market customer implementations from post-sales handoff through launch, aligning customer stakeholders, onboarding plans, and milestones.

• Guide customers through card setup, activation, and spend adoption, coordinating the operational and accounting workflows needed for rollout.

• Monitor onboarding progress and agreed spend goals, identify at-risk rollouts, and coordinate account-level actions to get implementation back on track.

• Coordinate resolution of customer issues with Support, Product, Risk, Underwriting, Finance, and other partners; route high-impact or complex escalations through established channels.

• Maintain clear account records and customer follow-through, and share implementation insights that contribute spend and into pilots and process improvements.

What We’re Looking For:

• 3+ years of experience in customer-facing roles such as onboarding or implementation, sales, client operations, financial products, or another complex product or service environment.

• Experience owning customer onboarding, rollout, adoption, or recovery plans for multi-stakeholder accounts, with attention to measurable customer outcomes.

• Working knowledge of customer onboarding, training, and spend-management workflows, including card issuance, spend controls, transaction declines, rebates, and reconciliation; ability to partner on related risk, credit, fraud, underwriting, or dispute issues.

• Experience leading live customer conversations- including calls, meetings, and product demos-and presenting product capabilities and financial workflows clearly and concisely

• Experience acting as a cross-functional liaison between customers and internal teams, translating customer goals and feedback into relevant product narratives and aligned actions, and coordinating resolution of customer-impacting issues.

job.title: Product Management Intern
job.description:
Product Management Intern – Identity Resilience

About the Team & Role
The Product Management team at Rubrik drives forward our vision of delivering a market-leading platform that addresses the world’s most critical cyber resilience and data security challenges.
The Identity Resilience team is Rubrik’s fastest-growing business unit, operating with a high-velocity "0-to-1" charter. Today, modern cyberattacks almost exclusively weaponize identity systems. When identity fails, the entire enterprise halts. Our mission is to ensure enterprise identity environments are secure, observable, compliant, and instantly recoverable.
We are looking for a strategically sharp, technical, and execution-minded Product Management Intern for a high-impact 2-month internship based in Bengaluru. As an intern, you will own a core strategic initiative – bridging enterprise customer pain points, competitive differentiation, and technical architecture to deliver a concrete product roadmap for next-generation identity protection.

What You’ll Do (2-Month Charter)

• Market Landscape & Threat Vector Analysis: Benchmark the enterprise identity attack surface across hybrid environments. Map emerging threat vectors to potential resilience and recovery capabilities.

• Customer Discovery & Pain Point Synthesis: Work alongside PM and GTM mentors to analyze customer requirements, telemetry data, and enterprise security frameworks to pinpoint the highest-friction operational gaps for Security and IAM teams.

• Feature Strategy & PRD Ownership: Define the scope, user workflows, and success metrics for a targeted identity protection/recovery feature. Author a high-quality Product Requirement Document (PRD) balancing enterprise-grade depth with Rubrik’s trademark simplicity.

• Cross-Functional Architecture Alignment: Collaborate closely with Engineering, UX Design, and Architecture leads to evaluate technical trade-offs, define API/data pipeline requirements, and ensure feasibility.

• Executive Strategy Pitch: Conclude your internship with an Executive Product Readout to Senior Leadership, defending your business case, technical trade-offs, and proposed roadmap.

What You’ll Need

• Education: Currently enrolled in a premier MBA/management program (IIM, ISB, or equivalent global top-tier business school) graduating in 2027/28

• Technical Foundation: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or an equivalent engineering discipline. Prior product management or technical experience in enterprise systems, cloud platforms, or cybersecurity is a strong plus.

• Systems & Security Thinking: An understanding of enterprise software fundamentals; familiarity with core identity concepts is an advantage.

• Problem Solving: Comfort with ambiguity, structured thinking, and the ability to break complex, undefined problems into crisp, actionable requirements.

• Communication & Influence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate technical trade-offs to senior product and engineering leaders.

• Location: Based in or willing to relocate to Bengaluru for the 2-month internship duration (Hybrid model).

What You’ll Gain

• True 0-to-1 Problem Ownership: Direct ownership of a real-world, high-priority product problem in enterprise cybersecurity – not a back-burner sandbox project.

• High-Stakes Leadership Visibility: Regular 1:1 mentorship from seasoned Product Managers and a final presentation to Product & Engineering leadership.

• Cybersecurity PM Expertise: Hands-on exposure to cutting-edge identity governance, threat modeling, and resilience frameworks inside an enterprise security market leader.

Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation
Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls.

As a Product Engineer at Dropbox, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of collaboration and file sharing. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, turning innovative ideas into robust, scalable, and user-friendly features.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes what’s expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here .

• Collaborating closely with product managers, designers, and analysts to understand user needs and develop products that meet those needs.

• Developing and executing short and long-term roadmaps, balancing business impact, user experience, and technical quality.
